उपगम्य: 1. उप-गम्य, अस्, आ, अम्, approachable, to be approached, attainable.
2. उप-गम्य or उप-गत्य, ind. having ap-proached.
उपगामिन्: उप-गामिन्, ई, इनी, इ, coming near, approaching.
उपगहन: उपगहन उप-गहन, अस्, m., N. of a Ṛṣi.
उपगा: उपगा 1. उप-गा, cl. 3. P. -जिगाति, -गातुम्, to go near to, arrive at, come into, undergo.
2. उप-गा, f. accompaniment of a song.
उपगाह्: उपगाह् उप-गाह्, cl. 1. A. -गाहते, -गाहितुम् or -गाढुम्, to penetrate; force one's way into.
उपगिरम्: उपगिरम् उप-गिरम्, ind. at a mountain.
उपगिरि: उप-गिरि, इस्, m. a country near a mountain; (इ), ind. near a mountain.
उपगु: उपगु उप-गु, उस्, m. (fr. उप and गो), N. of a prince; (उ), ind. near a cow.
उपगुप्त: उपगुप्त उप-गुप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, hidden, con-cealed; (अस्), m., N. of a man, the son of Gupta. —उपगुप्त-वित्त, अस्, आ, अम्, of concealed resources.
उपगुरु: उपगुरु उप-गुरु, उस्, m. an assistant teacher; N. of a prince; (a various reading has उप-गु।)
उपगुह्: उपगुह् उप-गुह्, cl. 1. P. A. -गूहति, -ते, गूहितुम् or -गोढुम्, to hide, cover, conceal, clasp, embrace.
उपगूढ: उप-गूढ, अस्, आ, अम्, hidden, concealed; lulled, suppressed; embraced; (अम्), n. an embrace. —उप-गूढ-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, one who has embraced.
उपगूहन: उप-गूहन, अम्, n. hiding, concealing; embrac-ing, an embrace; astonishment, surprise.
उपगोह्य: उप-गोह्य, अस्, m. a kind of fire considered as impure (and therefore to be hidden).
उपगॄ: उपगॄ 1. उप-गॄ, cl. 9. P. A., Ved. -गृणाति, -णीते, -गरितुम् or -रीतुम्, to call out to, invoke with hymns of praise; to approach with praise (with acc. of the person).
उपगॄ 2. उप-गॄ, cl. 6. P. -गिरति or -गिलति, -गरितुम्, -लितुम् or -रीतुम्, -लीतुम्, to swallow down.
उपगै: उपगै उप-गै, cl. 1. P. -गायति, -गातुम्, to sing to any one (with dat. or acc.), to join in singing; to sing before any one (with acc.); to fill with song, praise in song, sing, celebrate.
उपगातृ: उप-गातृ, ता, m. one who accompanies the song or recitation of the Udgātṛ priest, a chorister.
उपगीत: उप-गीत, अस्, आ, अम्, celebrated, proclaimed, sung by bards &c.
उपगीति: उप-गीति, इस्, f. a variety of the Āryā metre, a stanza of four lines, containing twice 12 + 15 syllabic instants.
उपगीय: उप-गीय, ind. having sung, having celebrated.
उपगीयमान: उप-गीयमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being celebrated.
उपगेय: उप-गेय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be sung or celebrated.
उपग्रन्थ्: उपग्रन्थ् उप-ग्रन्थ्, cl. 9. 1. 10. P. -ग्रथ्-नाति, -ग्रन्थति, -ग्रन्थयति, -ग्रन्थितुम्, -यि-तुम्, to intwine or wind round.
उपग्रन्थ: उप-ग्रन्थ, अस्, m. title of a writing or of a class of writings.
उपग्रस्: उपग्रस् उप-ग्रस्, cl. 1. P. A. -ग्रसति, -ते, -ग्रसितुम्, to swallow down, devour; to eclipse.
उपग्रह्: उपग्रह् उप-ग्रह्, cl. 9. P. A. -गृह्णाति, -णीते (Ved. -गृभ्णाति, -णीते), -ग्रहीतुम्, to col-lect (a fluid by holding one vessel under another), to hold under; to seize from below; to seize, take possession of, take, obtain; to subdue, become, master of; to bring near to (one's self), take as one's ally, conciliate, make favourable; to conceive with one's mind (धिया); to decide, to determine; to accept, approve.
उपग्रह: उप-ग्रह, अस्, m. seizure, confinement; a prisoner; subjoining, annexing; making favourable, appeasing, favour, encouragement, assistance; peace purchased by the cession of everything; the voice or pada of a verb; a heap of Kuśa grass; the presiding spirit or cause directing a planet's motion; (with उप implying in-feriority) a minor planet or any heavenly body of a secondary kind, as a comet, a meteor, a falling star, &c.
उपग्रहण: उप-ग्रहण, अम्, n. holding up, seizing from below; the taking any one prisoner, seizure, capture, taking, supporting, forwarding, promoting; holy study, reading the Vedas after initiation.
उपग्राह: उप-ग्राह, अस्, m. oblation, present, (what is ac-cepted.)
उपग्राह्य: उप-ग्राह्य, अस्, अम्, m. n. a present, an offering to a king or great man, a Nazr.
उपघात: उपघात उप-घात, अस्, m. (fr. rt. हन् with उप), a stroke, injury, damage, offence; touch, con-tact, especially with intent to injure; personal violence, assault; disease, sickness; a kind of oblation offered in small portions at a time.
उपघातक: उप-घातक, अस्, इका, अम्, or उप-घातिन्, ई, इनी, इ, injuring, hurting, offending.
उपघ्न: उप-घ्न, अस्, m. contiguous support; a contiguous resting-place, shelter, support, stay, protection; what rests upon or is supported by.
उपघुष्: उपघुष् उप-घुष्, cl. 1. P. -घोषति, -षि-तुम्, to fill with noise, make resonant.
उपघुष्ट: उप-घुष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, resounding with; reso-nant; sounding.
उपघोषण: उप-घोषण, अम्, n. proclaiming, publication, making known.
उपघ्रा: उपघ्रा उप-घ्रा, cl. 1. P. -जिघ्रति, -घ्रातुम्, to smell, smell at; to kiss: Caus. -घ्रापयति, -यितुम्, to cause to smell at or kiss.
उपचक्र: उपचक्र उप-चक्र, अस्, m. a variety of the ruddy goose, Cakra or Cakravāka.
उपचतुर: उपचतुर उप-चतुर, आस्, आस्, आणि, pl. almost four, nearly four.
उपचय: उप-चय, अस्, m. accumulation, increase, growth, prosperity; quantity, heap; elevation, excess; addi-tion; the third, sixth, tenth, and eleventh degrees from the first of a zodiacal sign. —उपचय-भवन, अम्, n. (?) according to some, a species of the Daṇ-ḍaka metre. —उपचयापचयौ (°य-अप्°), m. du. prosperity and decay, rise and fall.
उपचर्: उपचर् उप-चर्, cl. 1. P. A. -चरति, -ते, -चरितुम्, Ved. -रितवे, -वै, -रसे, -रध्यै, to come near, approach, go towards; to approach with the intention of serving, to assist, serve, attend, wait on (with acc.); to attend on a patient, to tend, nurse; to undertake; begin: Pass. -चर्यते, to be used figuratively or metaphorically, to be applied figuratively to any one (with loc.).
उपचर: उप-चर, अस्, m. approach; attendance, cure.
उपचरण: उप-चरण, अम्, n. going near to, approaching.
उपचरित: उप-चरित, अस्, आ, अम्, waited on, served, adored.
उपचर्य: 1. उप-चर्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be served or waited on, to be worshipped; (आ), f. service, attendance; practice of medicine, physicking.
2. उप-चर्य, ind. having approached or attended to; having groomed or tended (horses).
उपचार: उप-चार, अस्, m. approach, service, attendance, act of civility, obliging or polite behaviour; proceed-ing, practice; profession, usage; physicking, the prac-tice of medicine, tending the sick, nursing; behaviour, conduct; a ceremony, presenting offerings of water, betel, flowers, &c.; a present, a bribe; solicitation, request; incomplete act; a figure of speech, pre-tence, pretext, ellipsis, metaphor (e. g. उपचारात्, metaphorically); occurrence of स् and ष् in the place of Visarga in grammar; N. of a Pariśiṣṭa of the Sāma-veda. —उपचार-करण, अम्, n. or उपचार-कर्मन्, अ, n. or उपचार-क्रिया, f. offering presents, especially of perfumes, flowers, &c.; attention, service. —उपचार-पर, अस्, आ, अम्, diligent in service, serving diligently. —उपचार-परिभ्रष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, void of civility, destitute of kindness, churlish, uncourteous.
उपचारिन्: उप-चारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, attending, serving.
उपचार्य: उप-चार्य, अस्, m. practice of medicine.
उपचर्म: उपचर्म उप-चर्म or अम्, ind. on the skin, near the skin.
उपचारु: उपचारु उप-चारु, उस्, m. and उपचारु-मत्, आन्, m., N. of two Cakravartins.
उपचि: उपचि 1. उप-चि, cl. 5. P. A. -चिनोति, -नुते, -चेतुम्, to gather together; to heap up, collect, hoard up, accumulate, increase, strengthen; to cover over with: Pass. -चीयते, to be heaped together or accu-mulated, to increase, become strong; to better one's circumstances, be prosperous; to gain advantage, succeed, to be covered with.
उपचि 2. उप-चि, cl. 3. P., Ved. -चिकेति, -चे-तुम्, to honour, worship.
उपचायिन्: उप-चायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, increasing, being in good circumstances.
उपचाय्य: उप-चाय्य, अस्, m. a certain sacrificial fire; a place for holding sacrificial fire, a hearth, an altar.
उपचित्: उप-चित्, त्, f., Ved. a kind of disease, perhaps a swelling.
उपचित: उप-चित, अस्, आ, अम्, collected, gathered together, heaped up, increased, assembled; thriving, increas-ing; abundantly furnished with, plastered, smeared; burnt (?). —उपचित-रस, अस्, आ, अम्, augmented in feeling.
उपचिति: उप-चिति, इस्, f. accumulation, collection, abundance.
उपचीयमान: उप-चीयमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being collected or filled.
उपचेय: उप-चेय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be collected or heaped up.
उपचित्तचिन्त: उपचित्तचिन्त उपचित्त-चिन्त, अस्, m., N. of a son of Pāpīyas.
उपचित्र: उपचित्र उप-चित्र, अस्, m., N. of a man; (आ), f. the plants Salvinia Cuculluta and Croton Polyandra; N. of several metres, namely, 1. a variety of Mātrāsamaka, containing 4×16 syllabic instants; 2. a metre of four lines of eleven syllables each; 3. a metre of two lines of twenty-two syllables each.
उपचूलन: उपचूलन उप-चूलन, अम्, n. heating, burn-ing (?).
उपचृत्: उपचृत् उप-चृत्, cl. 6. P. -चृतति, -चर्तितुम्, to fasten, tie, bind on.
उपच्छद्: उपच्छद् 1. उप-च्छद् (उप-छद्), cl. 10. P. A. -छादयति, -ते, -यितुम्, to cover, hide, conceal, keep secret.

उपच्छद् 2. उप-च्छद् or -च्छन्द् (उप-छद्), Caus. -च्छन्दयति, -यितुम्, to present any one (acc.) with anything (inst.); to persuade a person to do anything; to coax, to seek to seduce a person; to conciliate.
उपच्छन्न: उप-च्छन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, secret, concealed.
उपच्छन्दन: उप-च्छन्दन, अम्, n. persuasion, persuading, coaxing.
उपच्यव: उपच्यव उप-च्यव, अस्, m. (rt. च्यु), Ved. pressing close to (in sexual intercourse); (Sāy.) going into (the chamber).
उपजगती: उपजगती उप-जगती, f. a variety of the Triṣṭubh metre, in which three Pādas contain twelve syllables instead of eleven.
उपजन्: उपजन् उप-जन्, cl. 4. A. -जायते, -जनितुम्, to be produced in addition, to be born, originate; to happen, become visible, appear; to be born again; to exist, be: Caus. -जनयति, -यितुम्, to produce, cause.
उपज: उप-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, being produced in addition, increasing; (अस्), m., N. of a divine being (?).
उपजन: उप-जन, अस्, m. additional production, addition, increase; appendage; addition of a letter in the forma-tion of words; letters, syllables or affixes added.
उपजा: उप-जा, f., Ved. distant or not immediate posterity.
उपजात: उप-जात, अस्, आ, अम्, produced, engendered, aroused. —उपजात-कोप or उपजात-क्रोध, अस्, आ, अम्, provoked, excited, moved to anger. —उपजात-विश्वास, अस्, आ, अम्, believing, confiding, confident, trusting.
उपजाति: उप-जाति, इस्, f. a mixed metre, especially a con-junction of Indravajrā and Upendravajrā, and a con-junction of Vaṃśastha and Indravaṃśa.
उपजप्: उपजप् उप-जप्, cl. 1. P. -जपति, -जपितुम्, to whisper into the ears (of another), to bring over to one's own party by secretly suggesting anything in the ear, to instigate to rebellion or treachery; to make mischief.
उपजप्य: उप-जप्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be brought over or in-stigated to rebellion by secret suggestions or whisper-ing in the ear.
उपजाप: उप-जाप, अस्, m. the act of whispering into the ears, rousing to rebellion, bringing over to one's own party; treason, treachery; disunion, separation.
उपजापक: उप-जापक, अस्, आ, अम्, whispering anything into the ears, rousing to rebellion; a traitor, treacherous; a mischief-maker, one who foments quarrels.
उपजरसम्: उपजरसम् उप-जरसम्, ind. towards old age, in old age.
उपजला: उपजला उप-जला, f., N. of a river.
उपजल्प्: उपजल्प् उप-जल्प्, cl. 1. P. -जल्पति, -पितुम्, to talk to, chatter, advise.
उपजल्पिन्: उप-जल्पिन्, ई, इनी, इ, talking to a person, giving advice.
उपजायम्: उपजायम् उप-जायम्, ind. near a wife.
उपजिगमिषु: उपजिगमिषु उप-जिगमिषु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. Desid. of rt. गम्), desirous of going near.
उपजिहीर्षा: उपजिहीर्षा उप-जिहीर्षा, f. (fr. Desid. of rt. हृ with उप), desire, intention to rob.
उपजिह्वा: उपजिह्वा उप-जिह्वा or उपजिह्विका, f. the uvula or soft palate, the epiglottis; enlargement of the under side of the tongue; a kind of ant.
उपजीक: उपजीक उपजीक, अस्, m., Ved. a water deity.
उपजीव्: उपजीव् उप-जीव्, cl. 1. P. -जीवति, -वितुम्, to live or exist upon (food), subsist, support one's self on, be supported by, derive profit from, make use of (with acc.); to live under, be dependant on, to serve; to live for a profession, practice.
उपजीव: उप-जीव, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. living on &c. (?).
उपजीवक: उप-जीवक, अस्, आ, अम्, living upon, subsisting by (with inst.); living under, depending upon, subject to, a dependant; (अम्), n. means of subsistence, act.
उपजीवन: उप-जीवन, अम्, n. means of living, subsistence.
उपजीवनीय: उप-जीवनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, granting means of sub-sistence, affording a livelihood.
उपजीविन्: उप-जीविन्, ई, इनी, इ, living on, subsisting by (with acc. or gen.); living in dependance, dependant, subject.
उपजीव्य: उप-जीव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, that by which one lives, affording a livelihood; (अम्), n. means of subsistence, cause.
उपजोषम्: उपजोषम् उप-जोषम्, ind. (rt. जुष्), ac-cording to one's desire or pleasure, quietly; an expres-sion indicative of joy.
उपज्ञा: उपज्ञा 1. उप-ज्ञा, cl. 9. A. -जानीते, -ज्ञातुम्, to ascertain; excogitate, invent, find out, hit upon: Desid. A., ep. also P. -जिज्ञासते, -ति, to seek to ascertain or invent.

2. उप-ज्ञा, f. a knowledge obtained by one's self and not handed down by tradition, primitive or un-taught knowledge, invention; commencement of a thing not previously done; (at the end of a compound used in neut., e. g. पाणिन्य्-उपज्ञम्, the grammar invented by Pāṇini.)
उपजिज्ञास्य: उप-जिज्ञास्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. enigmatical, unin-telligible, mysterious.
उपज्मन्: उपज्मन् उप-ज्मन्, आ, m., Ved. striding or stepping upon (?).
उपज्योतिष: उपज्योतिष उप-ज्योतिष, N. of a region.
उपज्रि: उपज्रि उप-ज्रि, cl. 1. P., Ved. -ज्रयति, -ज्रे-तुम्, to extend to; (Sāy.) to go near to, approach.
उपज्वलित: उपज्वलित उप-ज्वलित, अस्, आ, अम्, lighted up.
उपढौक्: उपढौक् उप-ढौक्, Caus. P. -ढौकयति, -यितुम्, to present an offering, make a respectful offering; carry out, accomplish.
उपढौकन: उप-ढौकन, अम्, n. a respectful offering or present, a Nazr.
उपतक्ष: उपतक्ष उप-तक्ष, अस्, m., N. of a certain semi-divine being, belonging to the class of Gandhar-vas or of Nāgas.
उपतटम्: उपतटम् उप-तटम्, ind. near the skirt; (अस्), m. (?) the skirt.
उपतप्: उपतप् उप-तप्, cl. 1. P. -तपति, -तप्तुम्, to make warm, to heat; to feel pain, become sick; to afflict, befal (as an illness; sometimes used im-personally with gen. or acc.): Pass. -तप्यते, to feel pain, become ill, be afflicted with; to be emaciated with penance (तपस्): Caus. -तापयति, -यितुम्, to kindle, ignite, burn, consume; to cause pain, ma-cerate the body by penance; torment, hurt, offend, oppress.
उपतपत्: उप-तपत्, अम्, m., Ved. (scil. अग्नि) interior heat, a disease.
उपतप्त: उप-तप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, heated, parched; distressed, pained.
उपतप्तृ: उप-तप्तृ, ता, m. morbid heat; any cause of heat, burning or inflammation.
उपतप्यमान: उप-तप्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being distressed.
उपताप: उप-ताप, अस्, m. heat, warmth, heating, paining, pain, trouble, misfortune; sickness, disease, injury; haste, hurry.
उपतापिन्: उप-तापिन्, ई, इनी, इ, heating, inflaming, exciting, causing pain; suffering heat or pain, sick.
उपतारक: उपतारक उप-तारक, अस्, इका, अम् (rt. तॄ), overflowing.
उपतिष्य: उपतिष्य उप-तिष्य, अस्, m., N. of a son of Tiṣya by Śārikā.
उपतीरम्: उपतीरम् उप-तीरम्, ind. on the shore.
उपतुष्: उपतुष् उप-तुष्, Caus. -तोषयति, -यितुम्, to content, satisfy.
उपतूलम्: उपतूलम् उप-तूलम्, ind. at the cotton.
उपतृण्य: उपतृण्य उप-तृण्य, अस्, m., Ved. epithet of a snake (lurking in grass).
उपत्य: उपत्य उपत्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. उप), situated under or below.
उपत्यका: उपत्यका, f. low-land, land at the foot of a hill or mountain; a forest at the foot of a mountain; a vale, valley.
उपदंश्: उपदंश् उप-दंश्, cl. 1. P. -दशति, -दंष्-टुम्, to bite or eat anything as a relish.
उपदंश: उप-दंश, अस्, m. a relish, anything to excite drinking or appetite, anything eaten in addition; biting, stinging; the venereal disease, chancre; a tree, the scraped root of which is used for horse-radish, Morunga Hyperanthera.
उपदंशिन्: उपदंशिन्, ई, इनी, इ, afflicted with the above disease.
उपदधि: उप-दधि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. placing upon.
उपदम्भ्: उपदम्भ् उप-दम्भ्, Caus. P., Ved. -दम्भ-यति, -यितुम्, to lesson, diminish, destroy.
उपदश: उपदश उप-दश, आस्, आस्, आनि, pl. almost ten, nearly ten.
उपदस्: उपदस् उप-दस्, cl. 4. P. -दस्यति, -सितुम्, to fail, be wanting, be extinguished, be exhausted, dry up; (in Ved. used impersonally with inst. or abl.): Caus. P. -दासयति, -यितुम्, to cause to fail or cease, extinguish.
उपदासुक: उप-दासुक, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. failing, wanting.
उपदह्: उपदह् उप-दह्, cl. 1. P. -दहति, -दग्धुम्, to burn, set fire to.
उपदा: उपदा 1. उप-दा, cl. 3. P. A. -ददाति, -दत्ते, दातुम्, to give in addition, offer, grant, give; to add: Ved. cl. 1. A. -ददते, to take upon one's self; to erect, support.
2. उप-दा, आस्, आस्, अम्, Ved. giving a present; (आ), f. a present, an offering to a king or great man &c.; a Nazr.
उपदान: उप-दान or उपदानक, अम्, n. an oblation, a present; a gift which is for the purpose of procuring favour or protection.
उपदानवी: उपदानवी उप-दानवी, f., N. of the daughter of the Dānava Vṛṣa-parvan and mother of Dush-manta.
उपदिग्ध: उपदिग्ध उप-दिग्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, (fr. rt. दिह् with उप), smeared, covered; spotted over.
उपदेह: उप-देह, अस्, m. a cover; liniment, ointment; (उप implying inferiority) a minor or secondary body growing on diseased parts of the body.
उपदेहिका: उप-देहिका, f. a kind of ant; [cf. उपजिह्विका।]
उपदिश्: उपदिश् 1. उप-दिश्, cl. 6. P. A. -दिशति, -ते, -देष्टुम्, to point out to; to indicate, specify, ex-plain, instruct, teach; advise, admonish; to assign the right place to anything, arrange; to mention, exhibit; to inform; to settle, prescribe; to dictate, command, govern; to name: Pass. -दिश्यते, to be taught &c., to be called.
2. उप-दिश्, क्, or उप-दिशा, f. an intermediate region, as north-east &c.
उपदिश: उप-दिश, अस्, m., N. of a son of Vasu-deva.
उपदिश्य: उप-दिश्य, ind. having advised or instructed.
उपदिष्ट: उप-दिष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, specified, particularized; taught, instructed, advised; assigned as a plea or reason; initiated; (अम्), n. council, advice.
उपदेश: उप-देश, अस्, m. pointing out to, instruction, teach-ing, informing, advice, prescription; specification; plea, pretext; initiation, communication of the initiatory Mantra or formula; (in gram.) a form in a rule, an indicatory form, i. e. a root, base, affix, augment, or any other word or part of a word furnished with in-dicatory letters (anubandhas) which serve as a guide to the application of particular grammatical rules and are rejected when the word or part of a word is ready for use. —उपदेश-ता, f. the state of being a precept or rule; injunction; manner of instructing; doc-trine. —उपदेश-सहस्री, f. title of a work of Śaṅkara on philosophy. —उपदेशार्थवक्य (°श-अर्°), अम्, n. a parable.
उपदेशक: उप-देशक, अस्, आ, अम्, giving instruction, in-structing, instructive, didactic; (अस्), m. an instructor, a guide, especially a spiritual guide.
उपदेशन: उप-देशन, अम्, n. advising, instructing; (आ), f. information, doctrine.
उपदेशिन्: उप-देशिन्, ई, इनी, इ, advising, instructing, inform-ing; (ई), m. a teacher, adviser; a word or affix &c. in the shape in which it appears in grammatical works.
उपदेश्य: उप-देश्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. to be taught; that which is to be taught or learnt.
उपदेष्टव्य: उप-देष्टव्य or उप-देशनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be taught or advised, fit or proper to be taught.
उपदेष्टृ: उप-देष्टृ, टा, ट्री, टृ, one who points out, an adviser, teacher; a Guru or spiritual guide.
उपदी: उपदी उपदी, f. the plant Vanda Roxburghii or Aërides Tesselata.
उपदीका: उपदीका उपदीका, f. a kind of ant; also उप-देहिका।
उपदीक्षिन्: उपदीक्षिन् उप-दीक्षिन्, ई, इणी, इ, sharing in an initiatory or other religious rite; a near relation.
उपदीप्: उपदीप् उप-दीप्, Caus. P. -दीपयति, -यितुम्, to kindle, set fire to.
उपदृश्: उपदृश् 1. उप-दृश्, cl. 1. P. -पश्यति, -द्रष्टुम्, to look at; to perceive, observe: Pass. -दृश्यते, to be or become visible, appear: Caus. -दर्शयति, -यितुम्, to cause to see, show, exhibit; to present a false show, impose upon another person by sham appearances; to illude; to explain, illustrate.
2. उप-दृश्, क्, f., Ved. a view, aspect.
उपदर्शक: उप-दर्शक, अस्, m. a guide, one who shows the way, a door-keeper.
उपदर्शित: उप-दर्शित, अस्, आ, अम्, perceived, distinguished.
उपदृष्टि: उप-दृष्टि, इस्, f. aspect, view, show.
उपद्रष्टृ: उप-द्रष्टृ, टा, ट्री, टृ, Ved. a supervisor, in-spector; overseeing, overlooking; (टा), m. a witness.
उपदृषद्: उपदृषद् उप-दृषद् or उप-दृषदम्, ind. near a boundary stone.
उपदेव: उपदेव उप-देव, अस्, m. an inferior deity; N. of a son of Akrūra; also of Devaka; (ई), f., N. of the wife of Vasu-deva; of a daughter of Devaka.
उपदेवता: उप-देवता, f. a minor deity, as a Yakṣa, Gan-darbha, Apsaras, &c.
उपदोह: उपदोह उप-दोह, अस्, m. (fr. rt. दुह् with उप), a nipple of the udder of a cow.
उपद्रु: उपद्रु उप-द्रु, cl. 1. P. -द्रवति, -द्रोतुम्, to run near to, run towards, run at, rush at, assault, attack.
उपद्रव: उप-द्रव, अस्, m. that which befalls suddenly, an unhappy accident, misfortune, calamity, mischief; national distress (whether the act of the seasons or the king, famine, exaction, &c.); national commotion, rebellion; violence, outrage; a symptom, a super-venient disease, one brought on whilst a person labours under another.
उपद्रविन्: उप-द्रविन्, ई, इणी, इ, attacking, falling on; tyran-nical, violent, factious; (ई), m. a tyrant, an oppressor, a rebel.
उपद्रुत: उप-द्रुत, अस्, आ, अम्, visited by calamities, op-pressed, attacked, persecuted, tyrannized over; (in astron.) eclipsed; boding evil, inauspicious; (अम्), n. a term of the Bāṣkalas for that kind of Sandhi, which is also called उद्ग्राहवत्, q. v.
उपद्वीप: उपद्वीप उप-द्वीप, अस्, m. an island.
उपधर्म: उपधर्म उप-धर्म, अस्, m. a minor or sub-ordinate duty; a by-law; a heretic, a schismatic.
उपधा: उपधा 1. उप-धा, cl. 3. P. A. -दधाति, -धत्ते, -धातुम्, to place or lay upon, place near to, put into; to place, lay; to put to (as horses to a carriage); to impose, lay upon, bestow upon, charge with (as a duty); to lay a command upon, enjoin, instruct in (with acc.); to place under one's self, to lie down upon; to place over, cover, conceal; to locate; to place in addition, to add; to communicate, cause to share in; (in gram.) to lie or be placed close to, to precede without the intervention of another syllable.

2. उप-धा, f. imposition, forgery, fraud, deceit, trick, a false pretence; trial or test of honesty &c., of four kinds, viz. of loyalty, disinterestedness, conti-nence, and courage; (in gram.) a penultimate letter. —उपधा-भृत, अस्, m. a servant who has been guilty of dishonesty. —उपधा-रञ्जन, अम्, n. nasalization of the penultimate (?). —उपधा-शुचि, इस्, इस्, इ, approved, tried, of approved loyalty &c.
उपधान: उप-धान, अम्, n. placing or resting upon; that on which one rests, a pillow, cushion; individuality, peculiarity; affection, kindness; religious observance or obligation; poison; excellence, excellent quality; (अस्, आ, अम्), employed in placing upon, i. e. used (as a Mantra) in the putting up (of the sacrificial bricks).
उपधानीय: उपधानीय, अम्, n. a pillow, cushion.
उपधाय: उप-धाय, ind. having placed or rested upon.
उपधायिन्: उप-धायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, placing under.
उपधि: उप-धि, इस्, m. the part of a wheel between the nave and the circumference; fraud, circumvention; fear, terror; foundation, (with Buddhists) substratum (?).
उपधिक: उपधिक, अस्, m. a cheat, a knave, especially one who imposes by threats, fraud.
उपधीयमान: उप-धीयमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being preceded by.
उपधेय: उप-धेय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be placed upon.
उपहित: उपहित उप-हित, अस्, आ, अम् (past pass. part. of 1. उप-धा, p. 163), placed, deposited, placed in or upon; preceded by; laid aside, joined; mixed; ready, deputed to act as a spy, connected with. —उपहित-भर, अस्, आ, अम्, having the weight carried; (a better reading has अप-हृत-।)
उप-हित; add — good in a secondary degree, somewhat good; (अम्), n. a secondary good.
उपधातु: उपधातु उप-धातु, उस्, m. an inferior mine-ral, a semi-metal, (seven are specified; pyrites, sulphate of copper, talc, antimony, red orpiment, yellow orpi-ment, and calx of brass); secondary secretion of the body, as the milk, menses, adeps, sweat, teeth, hair, and lymph.
उपधारण: उपधारण उप-धारण। See under उप-धृ below.
उप-धारण, अम्, n. considering, consideration, reflection.
उपधाव्: उपधाव् उप-धाव्, cl. 1. P. A. -धावति, -ते, -वितुम्, to run near to, approach hastily; have re-course to for assistance; A. to run, glide, soar.
उपधूपित: उपधूपित उप-धूपित, अस्, आ, अम्, fumigated; one to whom decline or death is near; being at the point of death; suffering extreme pain.
उपधृ: उपधृ उप-धृ, Caus. P. -धारयति, -यितुम्, to hold up, support, bear, carry; to hold as, consider as, regard as; to hold in the mind, to comprehend, perceive, hear, experience, observe; to reflect or me-ditate on.
उपधार्य: उप-धार्य, ind. having taken or held up.
उपधृति: उप-धृति, इस्, f. a ray of light.
उपधे: उपधे उप-धे, Caus. A., Ved. -धापयते, -यितुम्, to rear by suckling.
उपध्मा: उपध्मा 1. उप-ध्मा, cl. 1. P. -धमति, -ध्मातुम्, to blow or breathe at or upon, fan.
2. उप-ध्मा, f. blowing upon, breathing; the effort of the voice which produces the sound Upa-dhmānīya.
उपध्मान: उप-ध्मान, अम्, n. blowing upon, breathing.
उपध्मानिन्: उपध्मानिन्, ई, इनी, इ, blowing upon, fanning, breathing.
उपध्मानीय: उप-ध्मानीय, अस्, m. the aspirate Visarga before the letters प् and फ्।
उपध्यै: उपध्यै उप-ध्यै, cl. 1. P., ep. also A. -ध्यायति, -ते, -ध्यातुम्, to think of, remember.
उपध्वस्त: उपध्वस्त उप-ध्वस्त, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. ध्वंस् with उप), Ved. spotted.
उपनक्षत्र: उपनक्षत्र उप-नक्षत्र, अम्, n., Ved. a secondary star.
उपनख: उपनख उप-नख, अम्, n. a disease of the finger-nails, whitlow, agnail.
उपनगर: उपनगर उप-नगर, अम्, n. a suburb.
उपनति: उप-नति, इस्, f., Ved. inclination, affection.
उपनदम्: उपनदम् उप-नदम् and उप-नदि, ind. near a river.
उपनन्द: उपनन्द उप-नन्द, अस्, m., N. of a son of Vasu-deva; a pupil of Śākya-muni; a king of the Nāgas.
उपनन्दक: उप-नन्दक, अस्, m., N. of a son of Dhṛta-rāṣṭra.
उपनम्: उपनम् उप-नम्, cl. 1. P. A. -नमति, -ते, -नन्तुम्, to bend towards, tend towards, approach; to come to, arrive at; to fall to the share of; share in (with acc., dat., or gen.): Caus. -नामयति, -यितुम्, to lead towards or into the presence of (with gen.), introduce to; to offer.
उपनत: उप-नत, अस्, आ, अम्, bent towards, bent inwards; brought under, subjected, surrendered; dependent on (for protection &c.); brought near to; fallen to one's share; approached, approximate, near (either in time or space); brought about, produced, existing.
उपनामुक: उप-नामुक, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. bending towards.
उपनय: उप-नय, अस्, m. bringing near, procuring; at-taining, gaining; employing; the fourth member in a fivefold syllogism, the application to the special case in question; leading a youth of the three first castes to a teacher; initiation; investiture with a pe-culiar thread or cord worn over the left shoulder and under the right, by which act spiritual birth is con-ferred and the youth is reckoned a member of the twice-born classes; (the cord of the Brāhman is of cotton, Munja or Kuśa grass; of the Kṣatriya, of Śaṇa or hemp; and of the Vaiśya, of wool: the youths should be invested, respectively, from eight to sixteen, from eleven to twenty-two, and from twelve to twenty-four years of age.)
उपनर: उपनर उप-नर, अस्, m., N. of a king of the Nāgas.
उपनह्: उपनह् उप-नह्, cl. 4. P. A. -नह्यति, -ते, -नद्धुम्, to tie up, tie together; to make up into a bundle, bind together; to inlay; to set with: Caus. -नाहयति, -यितुम्, to cause to bind together.
उपनहन: उप-नहन, अम्, n., Ved. a cloth in which any-thing is bound up.
उपनाह: उप-नाह, अस्, m. a bundle; a plaster, an unguent applied to a wound or sore; the tie of a lute, the lower part of the tail-piece where the wires are fixed; inflammation of the ciliary glands, stye.
उपनाहन: उप-नाहन, अम्, n. putting a plaster upon, apply-ing an unguent, unction, anointing, plastering.
उपनामन्: उपनामन् उप-नामन्, अ, n. a nickname, surname.
उपनासिक: उपनासिक उप-नासिक, अम्, n. the part sur-rounding, the nose, that which is near the nose.
उपनिक्षिप्: उपनिक्षिप् उप-नि-क्षिप्, cl. 6. P. A., 4. P. -क्षिपति, -ते, -क्षिप्यति, -क्षेप्तुम्, to throw down, place down, deposit.
उपनिक्षेप: उप-निक्षेप, अस्, m. a deposit sealed or covered up so that the contents are unknown; any article intrusted to one's keeping.
उपनिगम्: उपनिगम् उप-नि-गम्, cl. 1. P. -गच्छति, -गन्तुम्, to meet with, fall into, fall upon, fall into any state.
उपनिग्रह्: उपनिग्रह् उप-ग्रह्, cl. 9. P. A. -गृह्-णाति, -णीते (Ved. -गृभ्णाति, -णीते), -ग्रहीतुम्, to press down upon, bring near to.
उपनिधा: उपनिधा उप-नि-धा, cl. 3. P. A. -दधाति, -धत्ते, -धातुम्, to put or place near, to put down, place before any one (as a meal &c.), bring near, lead near to; to produce, cause; to deposit, to intrust.
उपनिधातृ: उप-निधातृ, ता, त्री, तृ, putting down, laying down.
उपनिधि: उप-निधि, इस्, m. a deposit, pledge, property put under the care of a creditor, friend, &c.; in law this word ordinarily implies especially a sealed deposit, but according to some, any article intrusted to a friend which he may use whilst in his keeping; N. of a son of Vasu-deva.
उपनिहित: उप-निहित, अस्, आ, अम्, deposited with, intrusted to; placed near to; offered, presented.
उपनिपत्: उपनिपत् उप-नि-पत्, cl. 1. P. -पतति, -ति-तुम्, to fly down to; to take place in addition; to be mentioned incidentally.
उपनिपात: उप-निपात, अस्, m. sudden and unexpected attack.
उपनिपातिन्: उप-निपातिन्, ई, इनी, इ, falling into; attacking suddenly.
उपनिपीड्: उपनिपीड् उप-नि-पीड्, cl. 10. P. -पीडयति, -यितुम्, to oppress, disturb.
उपनिमन्त्र्: उपनिमन्त्र् उप-नि-मन्त्र्, cl. 10. A. -मन्त्र-यते, -यितुम्, to invite, consecrate, inaugurate.
उपनिवपन: उपनिवपन उप-निवपन, अम्, n. (rt. वप्), scattering or pouring down upon.
उपनिवेशिन्: उपनिवेशिन् उप-निवेशिन्, ई, इनी, इ (rt. विश्), attached to, inherent, annexed.
उपनिषद्: उपनिषद् उप-निषद्, त्, f. (rt. सद् with उप and नि, implying originally sitting down at the feet of another in order to listen to his words, and hence confidential information given in this manner; but according to native authorities उप-नि-षद् means ‘to destroy ignorance by revealing the knowledge of the supreme spirit’); esoteric doctrine, secret doctrine, mysterious or mystical meaning, words of mystery &c.; certain mystical writings attached to the Brāhmaṇas, the aim of which is the ascertainment of the secret sense of the Veda, (they are more than a hundred in number, and are said to have been the source of the six darśanas or systems of philosophy; perhaps the most celebrated is the Bṛhad-āraṇyaka-upaniṣad attached to the Śata-patha-Brāhmaṇa); true know-ledge; a neighbouring mansion; a lonely place; (at the end of compounds उपनिषद् sometimes be-comes उपनिषद।) —उपनिषत्-कृ, to regard as a mystical or secret doctrine.
उपनिषादिन्: उप-निषादिन्, ई, इनी, इ, sitting at the feet of a person; subjected.
उपनिष्कर: उपनिष्कर उप-निष्कर, अम्, n. (rt. कृ), a street, a principal or royal road.
उपनिष्क्रम्: उपनिष्क्रम् उप-निष्-क्रम् (-निस्-क्रम्), cl. 1. P. A., 4. P. -क्रामति, -क्रमते (ep. also -क्रा-मते), -क्राम्यति, -क्रमितुम्, to go out towards, step out, go out.
उपनिष्क्रमण: उप-निष्क्रमण, अम्, n. going out towards; a particular religious rite, one of the Saṃskāras, taking a child in the fourth month of its age for the first time into the open air (see Manu 11. 34); a main or royal road.
उपनी: उपनी 1. उप-नी, cl. 1. P. A. -नयति, -ते, -नेतुम्, to lead near to, bring near, bring, adduce, offer; bring information, communicate; to bring about, produce; to employ, to bring into any state, bring into one's possession, lead away, lead; to bring near to one's self (as a teacher receives a pupil for in-struction), to invest with the sacred thread, initiate; A. to take into one's service: Caus. -नाययति, -यि-तुम्, to cause (a master) to receive (a pupil), to cause to invest with the sacred thread.
उपनी 2. उप-नी (उप-नि-इ), cl. 2. P. -न्येति, -तुम्, to enter into, penetrate.
उपनयन: उप-नयन, अम्, n. leading to, bringing; leading to a teacher, initiation. See उप-नय।
उपनाय: उप-नाय, अस्, m. or उप-नायन, अम्, n. leading to a teacher, initiation. See the preceding.

उपपादक: उप-पादक, अस्, आ, अम्, producing, effecting, making visible.

उपपालित: उपपालित उप-पालित, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. 2. पा), protected, nurtured.
उपपीड्: उपपीड् उप-पीड्, cl. 10. P. -पीडयति, -यितुम्, to press down, disturb, distress; (in astron.) to eclipse.

(fr. rt. मन् with उप), Ved. approaching with a prayer; addressing, address; (Sāy.) comparison; (इस्), m. approaching in a friendly way; obliging; one who may be addressed, affable, espe-cially as an epithet of Agni; (Sāy.) granting wealth. —उपमाति-वनि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. one who receives ad-dresses in a friendly way; (Sāy.) destroyer of an enemy.

उपमास्य: उपमास्य उप-मास्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. occur-ring every month, monthly.
उपमित्: उपमित् उप-मित्, त्, f., Ved, a prop, a stay.
उपमूलम्: उपमूलम् उप-मूलम्, ind. at the root.
उपमृद्: उपमृद् उप-मृद्, cl. 9. P. -मृद्नाति, -मर्दि-तुम्, to crush, bruise, dash to pieces, destroy; rub down.
उपमर्द: उप-मर्द, अस्, m. friction, rubbing down, bruising; destruction; reproach, abuse, refutation of a charge.
उपमर्दक: उप-मर्दक, अस्, आ, अम्, crushing, destroying, destructive; (अस्), m. refutation of a charge.
उपयज्: उपयज् उप-यज्, ड्, f., Ved., N. of eleven additional formulas at a sacrifice.
उपयष्टृ: उप-यष्टृ, टा, m., Ved. the priest who utters these verses.
उपयाज: उप-याज, अस्, m. additional formulas at a sacrifice; N. of a younger brother of Yāja.
उपयन्त्र्: उपयन्त्र् उप-यन्त्र्, cl. 10. P. -यन्त्रयति, -यितुम्, to solicit or compel any one to do anything.
उपयम्: उपयम् उप-यम्, cl. 1. P. A. -यच्छति, -ते, -यन्तुम्, to take a wife, marry; to seize, take, re-ceive, hold; to offer.
उपयन्त्र: उप-यन्त्र, अम्, n. (with उप implying inferi-ority) a minor surgical instrument or implement; a secondary application of any kind, as actual cautery, escharotics, &c.
उपयमन: उप-यमन, अम्, n. marrying; taking a wife; (ई), f. any support of stone, clay, gravel &c. for hold-ing fire-wood; a sacrificial ladle; (अस्, आ, अम्), that upon which anything is placed, a support.
उपयाम: उप-याम, अस्, m., Ved. taking up with a ladle; a ladle (?); the verses or formulas uttered in ladling out the Soma juice; marriage.
उपया: उपया उप-या, cl. 2. P. -याति, -तुम्, to ap-proach, undergo.
उपयात: उप-यात, अस्, आ, अम्, arrived; (अम्), n. arrival, return.
उपयान: उप-यान, अम्, n. coming near, approaching.
उपयायिन्: उप-यायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, coming towards, approaching.
उपयाचक: उपयाचक उप-याचक, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. याच्), an asker, solicitor, begging.
उपयाचन: उप-याचन, अम्, n. soliciting, approaching with a request or prayer.
उपयाचित: उप-याचित, अस्, आ, अम्, requested, solicited; offered, especially to the deities to render them propitious; (अम्), n. prayer, request (to a deity).
उपयिचारिक: उपयिचारिक उपयिचारिक, अस्, m. any one employed to guard a Vihāra; a wrong reading for उपविहारिक (?).
उपयुज्: उपयुज् उप-युज्, cl. 7. P. A. -युनक्ति, युन्-क्ते, -योक्तुम्, to harness (as horses to a carriage); to occupy, take possession of; to use, employ, apply; to bestow upon; to attach one's self to, be devoted to; to appropriate, consume, eat.
उपयुक्त: उप-युक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, attached, adapted, suitable, appropriate, useful; worthy, serviceable; proper, right; taken, eaten, touched.
उपयुञ्जान: उप-युञ्जान, अस्, आ, अम्, attaching, taking, appro-priating.
उपयुयुक्षु: उप-युयुक्षु, उस्, उस्, उ, about to employ or apply.
उपयोक्तव्य: उप-योक्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be employed.
उपयोग: उप-योग, अस्, m. application, employment, use, service, utility; administration of medicines, prepara-tion of them; fitness, suitableness; contact, proximity; any act tending to effect a desired object; good con-duct, observing established practices. —उपयोगं गम् or व्रज्, to be employed or used.
उपयोगिन्: उप-योगिन्, ई, इनी, इ, employing, using; what is employed, conducive or contributing to, serviceable, useful, convenient; appropriate; favourable, propitious; touching, in contact with. —उपयोगि-ता, f. or उप-योगि-त्व, अम्, n. usefulness; fitness, suitableness; occasion, need; favour, propitiousness.
उपयोजन: उप-योजन, अम्, n. harnessing a horse (by the side of another); a team.
उपयोज्य: उप-योज्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be employed or used.
उपयोषम्: उपयोषम् उप-योषम्, ind. a word express-ing great pleasure; [cf. उप-जोषम्।]
उपर: उपर उपर, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. उप), Ved. situ-ated below, under; posterior, later; nearer, approxi-mate; उपरासु (loc. fem. pl.), in the proximity of, near to; (अस्), m. the lower stone on which the Soma is laid that it may be ground by means of other stones held in the hands; the lower part of the sacri-ficial post; a cloud; region (?). —उपर-तात्, ind., Ved. in the proximity or circumference.
उपरक्त: उपरक्त उप-रक्त, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. रञ्ज् with उप), afflicted, overtaken by calamity; (अस्), m. eclipsed (as sun or moon), Rāhu the ascending node.
उपराग: उप-राग, अस्, m. colour; darkening, an eclipse of the sun or moon; Rāhu or the ascending node; an inauspicious event, calamity, affliction; misbehaviour, ill conduct; reproach, abuse.
उपरक्षण: उपरक्षण उप-रक्षण, अम्, n. a guard, an outpost.
उपरचित: उपरचित उप-रचित, अस्, आ, अम्, made, pre-pared.
उपरत्न: उपरत्न उप-रत्न, अम्, n. a secondary or inferior gem, a diamond of low value.
उपरम्: उपरम् उप-रम्, cl. 1. P. A. -रमति, -ते, -रन्तुम्, to cease, end, terminate, be finished; to desist; to cause to cease or desist: Caus. -रमयति, -यितुम्, to cause to cease or desist, stop, render quiet.
उपरत: उप-रत, अस्, आ, अम्, ceased, stopped; dead; withdrawn or retired from. —उपरत-कर्मन्, आ, आ, अ, ceasing from works or from relying on them. —उपरत-रास, अस्, आ, अम्, ceasing to dance or play. —उपरत-विषयाभिलाष (°य-अभ्°), अस्, आ, अम्, ceasing from all desire after worldly things. —उपरत-स्पृथ, अस्, आ, अम्, void of desire. —उपरतारि (°त-अरि), इस्, इस्, इ, having no foe, being at peace with all.
उपरति: उप-रति, इस्, f. ceasing, stopping; death; refrain-ing from sensual enjoyment, abstaining from prescribed acts; great or exquisite pleasure (?).
उपरम: उप-रम, अस्, m. stopping, ceasing; abstaining from, giving up; death.
उपरमण: उप-रमण, अम्, n. abstaining from the pleasures of sense or from ceremonial acts (with abl.); ceasing, discontinuance.
उपरव: उपरव उप-रव, अस्, m. (fr. rt. रु with उप), a sound-hole, (designation of certain holes which increase the sound of the stones when the Soma is being ground.)
उपरस: उपरस उप-रस, अस्, m. a secondary mine-ral, as red chalk, bitumen, &c.; a secondary passion or feeling; a subordinate flavour.
उपराज: उपराज उप-राज, अस्, m. a viceroy.
उपरि: उपरि उपरि, ind. (as a separable adverb) above, upon, on, upwards, towards the upper side of (opposed to अधस् and नीचा, e. g. उपरि या, to go upwards; sometimes written with a following word as if compounded with it, e. g. उपरि-चिह्नित, marked above); besides, in addition to, further (सहस्रं शतान्य् उपरि चाष्टौ, 1000 and 800 in addition); afterwards (e. g. उपरि पयः पिबेत्, he should drink milk afterwards); उपरि उपरि, higher and higher; repeatedly, continuously. (As a separable preposition, with acc., loc., or gen.) over, above, upon, on, at the head of, on the upper side of, beyond (e. g. उपरि शैलं गम्, to go over the mountain; उपरि लङ्कायां सम्प्राप्तः सः, he arrived over Laṅkā; उपर्य् उपरि सर्वेषाम् अतिष्ठत्, he stood at the very head of all; आत्मानं तस्य उपरि क्षिप्त्वा, having thrown himself upon him); in connection with, with reference to, with regard to, towards (with gen., e. g. मम उपरि विकारितः, changed in feeling with regard to me; पुत्रस्य उपरि क्रुद्धः, enraged towards his son); after (with abl., e. g. मुहूर्ताद् उपरि, after a minute); [cf. Zend upara; Goth. ufar; Old Germ. obar; Mod. Germ. über; Eng. over; Gr. ὑπέρ Lat. super.]
उपरि may also be used at the end of a compound; e. g. तदुपरि गन्तुम्, to fall upon him, to attack him.

उपरि often stands at the beginning of a com-pound, as in the following examples. —उपरि-गत, अस्, आ, अम्, gone up, ascended. —उपरि-चर, अस्, m. epithet of the king Vasu (‘walking in the air’). —उपरि-चित, अस्, आ, अम्, piled over or above. —उपरि-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, growing up, produced above, elevated, high. —उपरि-निहित, अस्, आ, अम्, laid over. —उपरि-पुरुष, अस्, आ, अम्, having a man above. —उपरि-प्रुत्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. coming from above. —उपरि-बभ्रव, अस्, m., N. of a teacher of the ritual. —उपरि-बुध्न, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. raised above the ground. —उपरि-भाग, अस्, m. the upper portion or side. —उपरि-भाव, अस्, m. the being above or higher. —उपरि-भूमि, इस्, f. the ground above. —उपरि-भ्रम्, cl. 1. 4. P. -भ्रमति, -भ्राम्यति, -भ्रमितुम्, to wander over or above. —उपरि-मर्त्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. above men. —उपरि-शयन, अम्, n., Ved. a place of rest. —उपरि-श्रेणिक, अस्, आ, अम्, being in the upper se-ries. —उपरि-सद्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. sitting or dwelling above. —उपरि-सद्य, अम्, n., Ved. the act of sitting above. —उपरि-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, staying or being above, upper. —उपरि-स्थापन, अम्, n. placing upon or above. —उपरि-स्थित, अस्, आ, अम्, standing above, being above, upper. —उपरि-स्पृश्, क्, क्, क्, Ved. raised, elevated. —उपरीतक (°रि-इत्°), अस्, m. a kind of coitus. —उपर्य्-आसन, अम्, n. sitting on high.
उपरितन: उपरितन, अस्, ई, अम्, upper (opposed to अधस्-तन).
उपरिष्टात्: उपरिष्टात्, ind. (as an adverb) above, from above; behind (opposed to पुरस्तात्), further on (in a book), later; afterwards; (as a preposition) over, upon, down upon (with acc. and gen.); behind (with gen.). —उपरिष्टाज्-ज्योतिष्मती, f., N. of a Vedic metre consisting of forty-three or forty-four syllables, the end of which is like the beginning of the metre Jyotiṣmatī. —उपरिष्टाज्-ज्योतिस्, इस्, f. a verse of the Triṣṭubh metre, the last Pāda of which consists of eight syllables. —उपरिष्टाद्-बृहती, f., N. of a Vedic metre consisting of four Pādas, the first of which contains twelve, each of the three others only eight syllables.
उपरुच्: उपरुच् उप-रुच्, cl. 1. A. -रोचते, -रोचितुम्, to shine, be brilliant.
उपरुध्: उपरुध् उप-रुध्, cl. 7. P. A. -रुणद्धि, -रुन्धे, -रोद्धुम्, to obstruct, hinder, molest, trouble, disturb; to prevent; to conceal.
उपरुद्ध: उप-रुद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, obstructed, impeded, molested, disturbed; covered, spread; protected, favoured.
उपरुध्य: उप-रुध्य, ind. having kept in check or ob-structed, having blockaded or hemmed in.
उपरुध्यमान: उप-रुध्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being besieged, besieged.
उपरोध: उप-रोध, अस्, m. surrounding, blockading; ob-struction, impediment, opposition, check, refusal; trouble, disturbance; binding, tying, taking hold of; protection, favour. —उपरोध-कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, causing trouble, obstructing.
उपरोधक: उप-रोधक, अम्, n. an inner room, a private apartment.
उपरोधिन्: उप-रोधिन्, ई, इनी, इ, obstructing, impeding; obstructed, impeded.
उपरुह्: उपरुह् उप-रुह्, cl. 1. P. -रोहति, -रोढुम्, to ascend, rise.
उपरूपक: उपरूपक उप-रूपक, अम्, n. a drama of an inferior class, of which eighteen are enumerated.
उपल: उपल उपल, अस्, m. (connected with उपर, q. v.), a rock or stone; a precious stone or jewel; (आ), f. the upper and smaller mill-stone which rests on the दृषद्; refined or candied sugar; [cf. Gr. ὤπαλος Lat. opalus.] —उपल-प्रक्षिन्, ई, इणी, इ, Ved. arranging stones; (Sāy.) throwing grain on the mill-stone. —उपल-भेदिन्, ई, m., N. of a plant.
उपलक्ष्: उपलक्ष् उप-लक्ष्, cl. 10. P. A. -लक्षयति, -ते, -यितुम्, to look at, observe, behold; to regard as, value as; to imply in addition: Pass. -लक्ष्यते, to be observed &c.; to be likely.
उपलक्षक: उप-लक्षक, अस्, आ, अम्, observing, designating.
उपलक्षण: उप-लक्षण, अम्, n. looking at; observation; designation; implying something that has not been expressed, implying something in addition or any ana-logous object where only one is specified, using a term in a generic sense, metaphorical or elliptical expression, synecdoche of a part for the whole, of an individual for the species or of a quality for that in which it re-sides; mark. —उपलक्षण-त्व, अम्, n. the being implied.
उपलक्षयितव्य: उप-लक्षयितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be observed.
उपलक्षित: उप-लक्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, comprehended, discovered, included, implied, metaphorically expressed, under-stood, characterized.
उपलक्ष्य: उप-लक्ष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, inferable; (अस्), m. a prop, stay, support, asylum; an inference.
उपलधिप्रिय: उपलधिप्रिय उपलधिप्रिय, अस्, m. the Bos grunniens; perhaps a wrong form for बालधि-प्रिय, ‘valued for its tail.’
उपलभ्: उपलभ् उप-लभ्, cl. 1. A. -लभते, -लब्-धुम्, to acquire, receive, accept, obtain, find; to conceive, become pregnant; to perceive, observe, hear, understand; [cf. Gr. ὑπολαμβάνω]
उपलब्ध: उप-लब्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, obtained, received; con-ceived; perceived, understood, known, guessed. —उपलब्ध-सुख, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has ex-perienced pleasure. —उपलब्धार्थ (°ध-अर्°), अस्, आ, अम्, having the meaning understood; (आ), f. a tale, a true or probable story.
उपलब्धव्य: उप-लब्धव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be observed.
उपलब्धि: उप-लब्धि, इस्, f. obtaining, acquisition, gain; observation, perception, knowledge (especially re-ligious), understanding, mind; a guess; appearance, perceptibility; [cf. Gr. ὑπόληψις] —उपलब्धि-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, perceptible, intelligible.
उपलभ्य: 1. उप-लभ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, obtainable, perceivable, to be understood.
2. उप-लभ्य, ind. having perceived or observed.
उपलभ्यमान: उप-लभ्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being perceived. —उपलभ्यमान-त्व, अम्, n. the being known.
उपलम्भ: उप-लम्भ, अस्, m. acquisition; apprehension, con-ception, comprehension otherwise than from memory.
उपलम्भक: उप-लम्भक, अस्, आ, अम्, causing to observe, reminding.
उपलम्भ्य: उप-लम्भ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, obtainable, to be ac-quired; respectable, commendable, praiseworthy.
उपलाभ: उप-लाभ, अस्, m., Ved. seizing or taking hastily.
उपलिप्सित: उप-लिप्सित, अस्, आ, अम्, wishing to take or seize.
उपलिप्सु: उप-लिप्सु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing to obtain or know.
उपलिङ्ग: उपलिङ्ग उप-लिङ्ग, अस्, m. a portent, a natural phenomenon considered as boding evil.
उपलिप्: उपलिप् उप-लिप्, cl. 6. P. A. -लिम्पति, -ते, -लेप्तुम्, to defile, anoint, smear, besmear: Caus. -लेपयति, -यितुम्, to cause to anoint or besmear.
उपलिप्त: उप-लिप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, anointed, smeared, plastered.
उपलेप: उप-लेप, अस्, m. smearing, anointing, plastering; obstruction, the being concealed; becoming deadened or dull.
उपलेपन: उप-लेपन, अम्, n. smearing, anointing, plaster-ing; an ointment, an unguent.
उपलेपिन्: उप-लेपिन्, ई, इनी, इ, serving as an ointment; anointing, smearing, obstructing.
उपलेख: उपलेख उपलेख, अस्, m. (fr. rt. लिख् with उप), title of a grammatical work connected with the Prātiśākhyas.
उपवक्तृ: उपवक्तृ उप-वक्तृ, ता, m., Ved. one who directs and animates by his words; animating.
उपवङ्ग: उपवङ्ग उप-वङ्ग, आस्, m. pl., N. of a country.
उपवञ्च्: उपवञ्च् उप-वञ्च्, Caus. -वञ्चयति, -यितुम्, to deceive; to repudiate.
उपवट: उपवट उप-वट, अस्, m. the tree Buchanania Latifolia.
उपवद्: उपवद् उप-वद्, cl. 1. A. -वदते, -दितुम्, to talk over, conciliate; to flatter, cajole.
उपवाद: उप-वाद, अस्, m., Ved. censure, blame.
उपवादिन्: उप-वादिन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. censuring, blaming.
उपवन: उपवन उप-वन, अम्, n. a small forest, a grove, a garden; a planted forest.
उपवर्ण्: उपवर्ण् उप-वर्ण्, cl. 10. P. -वर्णयति, -यितुम्, to tell or describe copiously.
उपवर्ण: उप-वर्ण, अस्, m. minute description, detail.
उपवर्णन: उप-वर्णन, अम्, n. description, minute de-scription, delineation.
उपवर्त: उप-वर्त, अस्, m. a particular high number.
उपवर्ष: उपवर्ष उप-वर्ष, अस्, m., N. of a son of Śaṅkara-svāmin and younger brother of Varṣa, author of writings on the Mīmāṃsa philosophy.
उपवल्गितनयन: उपवल्गितनयन उपवल्गित-नयन, अस्, आ, अम्, swollen or dimmed with tears; (a various read-ing has अपवल्गित-°।)
उपवल्लिका: उपवल्लिका उप-वल्लिका, f., N. of a plant.
उपवल्ह: उपवल्ह उप-वल्ह, अस्, m., Ved. emulation, rivalry.
उपवस्: उपवस् उप-वस्, cl. 1. P. -वसति, -वस्तुम्, to dwell in or at; to abide in a state of abstinence, abstain from food, to fast: Caus. -वासयति, -यितुम्, to cause to fast.
उपवसथ: उप-वसथ, अस्, m., Ved. a fast-day, day of pre-paration for the Soma sacrifice, the day preceding a Soma sacrifice, day of a Soma sacrifice; a village (?).

उपवस्त: उप-वस्त, अम्, n. a fast, fasting.

उपसादित: उप-सादित, अस्, आ, अम्, approached, come near to.
उपसन्तन्: उपसन्तन् उप-सन्-तन् (-सम्-त्°), cl. 8. P. A. -तनोति, -नुते, -नितुम्, to bring into immediate connection with.
उपसन्तान: उप-सन्तान, अस्, m. immediate connection, join-ing together; a descendant.
उपसन्धा: उपसन्धा उप-सन्-धा (-सम्-धा), cl. 3. P. A. -दधाति, -धत्ते, -धातुम्, to put together, add, increase; to join, connect, cause to partake of; to aim at.
उपसंहित: उप-संहित, अस्, आ, अम्, connected with, furnished with, accompanied or surrounded by; having regard or reference to, attached to one another.
उपसन्ध्यम्: उपसन्ध्यम् उप-सन्ध्यम्, ind. near or towards evening.
उपसन्न्यास: उपसन्न्यास उप-सन्न्यास, अस्, m. (rt. 2. अस्), laying down, giving up.
उपसमश्: उपसमश् उप-सम्-अश्, cl. 5. P. A. -अश्नोति, -नुते, -शितुम्, to reach, obtain.
उपसमस्: उपसमस् उप-सम्-अस्, cl. 4. P. -अस्यति, -सि-तुम्, to put or place upon.
उपसमाकृ: उपसमाकृ उप-सम्-आ-कृ, cl. 5. 8. P. A. -कृ-णोति, -णुते, -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्तुम्, to connect, combine together.
उपसमाधा: उपसमाधा उप-सम्-आ-धा, cl. 3. P. A. -द-धाति, -धत्ते, -धातुम्, to put on (as wood on a fire), to place in order, arrange.
उपसमाधान: उप-समाधान, अम्, n. placing in or on, laying one upon the another.
उपसमाहार्य: उपसमाहार्य उप-समाहार्य, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. हृ), to be brought together, to be arranged.
उपसमि: उपसमि उप-सम्-इ, cl. 2. P. -एति, -तुम्, to approach together.
उपसमिद्: उपसमिद् उप-समिद् or उप-समिधम्, ind. near the fire-wood.
उपसमूह्: उपसमूह् उप-सम्-ऊह्, cl. 1. P. -ऊहति, -हि-तुम्, to draw together, contract, to collect together, to bring near.

उपसम्पद्: उपसम्पद् उप-सम्-पद्, cl. 4. A. -पद्यते, -पत्तुम्, to come to, arrive at: Caus. P. -पादयति, -यितुम्, to bring near to, lead near, to give, grant; (with Buddhists) to receive into the order of priests, to ordain.
उपसम्पत्ति: उप-सम्पत्ति, इस्, f. approaching, arriving at, entering into any condition.
उपसम्पन्न: उप-सम्पन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, arrived at; gained, obtained; furnished with; familiar with; finished; enough, sufficient; dead, deceased; immolated, sacri-ficed as a victim &c.; dressed, cooked.
उपसम्प्रछ्: उपसम्प्रछ् उप-सम्-प्रछ्, cl. 6. P. -पृच्-छति, -प्रष्टुम्, to ask a person about anything.
उपसम्प्राप्: उपसम्प्राप् उप-सम्-प्राप् (-प्र-आप्), cl. 5. P. -आप्नोति, -प्तुम्, to reach, obtain, approach.
उपसम्भाषा: उपसम्भाषा उप-सम्भाषा, f. talking over, friendly persuasion.
उपसर: उपसर उप-सर। See उप-सृ next col.
उप-सर, अस्, आ, or ई, अम्, who or what approaches; (अस्), m. approaching (a cow); the first pregnancy or impregnation of a cow.
उपसर्ग: उपसर्ग उप-सर्ग। See उप-सृज् next col.

उप-सर्ग, अस्, m. addition; trouble, misfortune; a portent, a natural phenomenon supposed to forbode future evil, an eclipse; a disease, possession by an evil spirit; change occasioned by any disease; indi-cation or symptom of death; a disease superinduced on another; an inseparable particle or preposition prefixed to roots; see कर्म-प्रवचनीय. —उप-सर्ग-वृत्ति, इस्, इस्, इ, having the character of a preposition, to be treated like one.
उपसर्पण: उपसर्पण उप-सर्पण। See उप-सृप् next col.
उप-सर्पण, अम्, n. approaching, advancing towards.
उपसि: उपसि उपसि, ind., Ved. in the lap, on the hip.
उपसुन्द: उपसुन्द उप-सुन्द, अस्, m., N. of a Daitya, son of Nikumbha and younger brother of Sunda.
उपसूर्यक: उपसूर्यक उप-सूर्यक, अम्, n. the disk of the sun.

उपसरण: उप-सरण, अम्, n. going or flowing towards, rapid flowing of the blood towards the heart in sick-ness; what is approached as a refuge.
उपसर्तव्य: उप-सर्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be approached for help, to be had recourse to.
उपसर्या: उप-सर्या, f. ‘to be approached,’ a cow fit for a bull.
उपसार्य: उप-सार्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be approached or gone to.
उपसृत्य: उप-सृत्य, ind. having gone towards, having ap-proached.
उपसृज्: उपसृज् उप-सृज्, cl. 6. P. -सृजति, -स्रष्टुम्, to pour out or on, to offer, make an oblation; to join, attach, connect with; to beset with, oppress; to eclipse.
उपसर्जन: उप-सर्जन, अम्, n. pouring on; misfortune, inauspicious phenomenon, portent, eclipse; passing by, leaving, eclipsing; any person or thing subordi-nate or subsidiary to another, a substitute, a repre-sentative; (in gram.) a word which by composition or derivation loses its original independance, while it also determines the sense of another word; for instance, in the derivative औपिशल, a pupil of Api-śali, अपिशलि has become the उपसर्जन; so also in the compound राज-पुरुष (fr. राजन् and पुरुष) the first loses its independant character when com-pounded and is therefore the उपसर्जन; (ई), f. an infusion.
उपसृष्ट: उप-सृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, joined, attached, connected to or with, attended by or accompanied with; seized or possessed by (evil demons &c.); eclipsed, as the sun or moon; furnished with an उपसर्ग or prepo-sition (e. g. the root दा with आ prefixed is said to be उपसृष्ट); (अम्), n. coition, copulation.
उपसृप्: उपसृप् उप-सृप्, cl. 1. P. A. -सर्पति, -ते, -सर्प्तुम् or -स्रप्तुम्, to creep near, approach; move onward, attack; [cf. ὑφέρπω]
उपसर्प: उप-सर्प, अस्, m. approach, access, following a person.
उपसर्पिन्: उप-सर्पिन्, ई, इणी, इ, creeping near, approaching.
उपसेक्तृ: उपसेक्तृ उप-सेक्तृ, ता, m. (rt. सिच्), Ved. one who sprinkles or pours one thing on another.
उपसेचन: उप-सेचन, अस्, आ, अम्, pouring or sprinkling one thing on another; (अम्), n. pouring or sprinkling upon, watering; infusion, juice; (ई), f. a ladle or cup for pouring.
उपसेन: उपसेन उप-सेन, अस्, m., N. of a pupil of Śākya-muni.
उपसेव्: उपसेव् उप-सेव्, cl. 1. A. -सेवते, -वितुम्, to serve, worship, honour; to practise, pursue, culti-vate, study, make use of, be addicted to, frequent, inhabit.
उपसेवक: उप-सेवक, अस्, आ, अम्, worshipping, following, practising.
उपसेवन: उप-सेवन, अम्, n. worshipping, honouring; ser-vice, addiction to; using, enjoying.
उपसेविन्: उप-सेविन्, ई, इनी, इ, serving, worshipping, honour-ing; liking, pleased with.
उपस्कृ: उपस्कृ उप-स्-कृ (स् inserted, see उप-कृ), cl. 8. A. -कुरुते, -कर्तुम्, to prepare, elaborate, perfect, adorn, &c.
उपस्कर: उपस्-कर, अस्, m. any article which serves to make complete, an ingredient, condiment, spice or seasoning (mustard, pepper, &c.); an appurtenance, utensil, implement or instrument; an article of house-hold use (as a broom, a basket, &c.), apparatus; blame, censure.
उपस्कार: उपस्-कार, अस्, m. anything additional, a supple-ment.
उपस्कृत: उपस्-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, prepared; blamed, censured.
उपस्कृति: उपस्-कृति, इस्, f. a supplement, anything additional.
उपस्तम्भ्: उपस्तम्भ् उप-स्तम्भ्, cl. 5. 9. P. -स्तभ्नोति, नाति, -स्तब्धुम्, to stay, prop, support.
उपस्तम्भ: उप-स्तम्भ, अस्, m. (also written उप-ष्टम्-भ ?), stay, support, support of life (as food, sleep, and government of the passions); encouragement, incitement; base, basis, ground, occasion.
उपस्तम्भक: उप-स्तम्भक, अस्, आ, अम्, supporting, promoting, encouraging.
उपस्तम्भन: उप-स्तम्भन, अम्, n., Ved. a support.
उपस्तरण: उप-स्तरण, अम्, n., Ved. spreading out, scatter-ing; what is spread out; a covering.
उपस्ति: उपस्ति उप-स्ति, इस्, m. (fr. rt. 1. अस् with उप), Ved. an attendant, a follower, a servant, a subject.
उपस्तु: उपस्तु उप-स्तु, cl. 2. P. A. -स्तौति or -स्त-वीति, -स्तुते or -स्तुवीते, -स्तोतुम्, to praise, invoke.
उपस्तुत्: उप-स्तुत्, त्, f., Ved. invocation, praise, invitation.

उपस्तुति: उप-स्तुति, इस्, f., Ved. invocation, praise.
उपस्तुत्य: उप-स्तुत्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be praised or invoked.
उपस्तृ: उपस्तृ उप-स्तृ or -स्तॄ, cl. 5. 9. P. A. -स्तृ-णोति, -णुते, -णाति, -णीते, -स्तर्तुम्, -रितुम् or -री-तुम्, to spread, arrange, set in order; [cf. Lat. substerno.]
उपस्तिर्: उप-स्तिर्, f., Ved. scattering about, spreading; what is spread; a covering.
उपस्तीर्ण: उप-स्तीर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, spread out, arranged.

A. -तिष्ठति, -ते, -स्थातुम्, to stand near, stand by the side of in order to serve, wait on, attend on, serve (with acc.); to be or remain near; stay with; to come near, approach; to approach a god with prayer, worship; to stand under in order to support; to approach for inter-course, have intercourse with; to approach for assist-ance; to approach with hostile intentions, attack; to occur, come to pass, arise, be present; to meet with, obtain; to fall to one's share, come to the possession of; to conciliate: Caus. P. -स्थापयति, -यितुम्, to cause to stand near, to provide, present, furnish with, place upon or near; to produce.
2. उप-स्था, आस्, आस्, अम्, Ved. standing on.
उपस्थ: उप-स्थ, अस्, m. the lap, middle part in general, a secure place; (अस्, अम्), m. n. the organs of genera-tion, especially of a woman; the anus; the haunch or hip; (अस्, आ, अम्), near, proximate; उपस्थं कृ, to sit down with the legs bent, make a lap; उपस्थे कृ, to take on one's lap. —उपस्थ-दघ्न, अस्, ई, अम्, reaching to the lap. —उपस्थ-निग्रह, अस्, m. restraint of sensual appetite; con-tinence. —उपस्थ-पत्त्र, अस्, m. the Indian fig tree. —उपस्थ-सद्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. sitting in the lap.
उपस्थातृ: उप-स्थातृ, ता, m. an attendant, servant.
उपस्थान: उप-स्थान, अम्, n. standing near, presence, proximity, nearness; approaching, appearing, coming into the presence of, introducing one's self; worship-ping, waiting on; attendance; obeisance; abode; an assembly; any object approached with respect, a sanctuary; obtaining, getting; उपस्थानं कृ, to give access or scope for action. —उपस्थान-शाला, f. the assembly-room of a Buddhist monastery.
उपस्थानीय: उप-स्थानीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be stayed with or near, to be kept near; to be attended on or served.
उपस्थापक: उप-स्थापक, अस्, आ, अम्, placing or bringing near, causing to obtain; explaining, teaching, a teacher.
उपस्थापन: उप-स्थापन, अम्, n. placing near; attendance, service.
उपस्थापनीय: उप-स्थापनीय or उप-स्थापयितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be placed near.
उपस्थापित: उप-स्थापित, अस्, आ, अम्, placed near, attended.
उपस्थाप्य: उप-स्थाप्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be placed near, to be produced or made visible.
उपस्थाय: उप-स्थाय, ind. having approached, having brought near to or assembled.
उपस्थायक: उप-स्थायक, अस्, m. a servant; (with Buddhists) a follower of Buddha.
उपस्थायिन्: उप-स्थायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, standing near, being pre-sent, appearing.
उपस्थावर: उप-स्थावर, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. stopping, not moving.
उपस्थित: उप-स्थित, अस्, आ, अम्, approached, arrived, arisen, appeared, present; staying by or near at hand, im-pending, ready; received, obtained, gained; accom-plished, taken place, happened; caused, occasioned; felt; known; clean, cleansed; (in Ved. gram.) in the Pada text followed by the particle इति; (अम्), n. the particle इति used in this manner; the position of words before and after इति; (आ), f., N. of a metre of four lines of ten syllables each; N. of another metre of four lines of eleven syllables each. —उपस्थित-प्रचुपित, N. of a metre consisting of four lines and fifty-one syllables. —उपस्थित-वक्तृ, ता, m. a ready speaker, an eloquent man. —उपस्थित-सम्प्रहार, अस्, आ, अम्, about to engage in a battle, having battle at hand.
उपस्थिति: उप-स्थिति, इस्, f. standing near, approach, presence, proximity, arrival; obtaining, getting; effecting, ac-complishing; remaining.
उपस्थेय: उप-स्थेय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be attended to, to be worshipped.
उपस्नेह: उपस्नेह उप-स्नेह, अस्, m. (rt. स्निह्), moisten-ing, attracting moisture.
उपस्पिज्: उपस्पिज् उप-स्पिज् (only used in acc. -जम्), Ved. inconsiderate curiosity or jest (?).
उपस्पृश्: उपस्पृश् 1. उप-स्पृश्, cl. 6. P. -स्पृशति, -स्प्रष्टुम् or -स्पर्ष्टुम्, to touch (water); to wash or rinse the mouth; to sip water, to sprinkle; to wash off; to gnash (the teeth).
2. उप-स्पृश्, क्, क्, क्, Ved. touching.
उपस्पर्श: उप-स्पर्श, अस्, m. touching, contact; washing, bathing, ablution; rinsing the mouth, sipping water and ejecting it.
उपस्पर्शन: उप-स्पर्शन, अम्, n. touching; bathing; rinsing the mouth.
उपस्पर्शिन्: उप-स्पर्शिन्, ई, इनी, इ, touching, sipping water.
उपस्पृष्ट: उप-स्पृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, touched, sipped.
उपस्मृति: उपस्मृति उप-स्मृति, इस्, f. a minor law-book; eighteen such books are mentioned.
उपस्रवण: उपस्रवण उप-स्रवण, अम्, n. (rt. स्रु), flowing, the periodical flow of a woman.
उपस्वत्व: उपस्वत्व उपस्व-त्व, अम्, n. revenue, profit, what is derived from land or other capital.
उपस्वावत्: उपस्वा-वत्, आन्, m., N. of a son of Satrājit.
उपस्वेद: उपस्वेद उप-स्वेद, अस्, m. (rt. स्विद्), moisture.
उपहन्: उपहन् उप-हन्, cl. 2. P. -हन्ति, -तुम्, to kill, injure, destroy, disturb, vex; to waste.
उपहत: उप-हत, अस्, आ, अम्, injured, impaired, evilly affected by; struck by lightning &c.; pained, hurt; destroyed; infected, polluted, vitiated; impure. —उप-हत-दृश्, क्, क्, क्, dazzled, blinded. —उपहत-धी, ईस्, ईस्, इ, infatuated. —उपहतात्मन् (°त-आत्°), आ, आ, अ, agitated in mind, mentally affected as by passion.
उपहतक: उपहतक, अस्, आ, अम्, ill-fated, unfortunate, un-lucky.
उपहत्नु: उप-हत्नु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. assailing.
उपहत्या: उप-हत्या, f. dazzling of the eyes.
उपहन्तव्य: उप-हन्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be killed.
उपहन्तृ: उप-हन्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, having a contrary effect, disturbing.
उपहरण: उप-हरण, अम्, n. bringing near; offering gifts to superiors; presenting victims; distributing or serving out food; taking, seizing.
उपहस्: उपहस् उप-हस्, cl. 1. P. -हसति, -सितुम्, to laugh at, deride.
उपहसित: उप-हसित, अम्, n. satirical laughter, laughing; (अस्, आ, अम्), laughed at, derided.
उपहस्वन्: उप-हस्वन्, आ, आ, अ, Ved. laughing at, a derider.
उपहास: उप-हास, अस्, m. fun, play, ridicule, derision, laughing at any one, satirical laughter. —उपहासा-स्पद (°स-आस्°), अम्, n. a laughing-stock.
उपहासक: उप-हासक, अस्, आ, अम्, ridiculing others, jocose; (अस्), m. a jester.
उपहास्य: उप-हास्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be laughed at, ridi-culous, laughable. —उपहास्य-ता, f. ridiculousness. —उपहास्य-तां गम्, to expose one's self to laughter.
उपहस्तिका: उपहस्तिका उपहस्तिका, f. (fr. उप-हस्त), a small bag or box containing condiments or betel.
उपहा: उपहा उप-हा, cl. 3. A. -जिहीते, -हातुम्, to go down, descend.
उपहालक: उपहालक उपहालक, आस्, m. pl., N. of a country, part of the peninsula of India.
उपहिंस्: उपहिंस् उप-हिंस्, cl. 7. 1. P. -हिनस्ति, -हिं-सति, -सितुम्, to injure, hurt, wound; to overpower.
उपहृ: उपहृ उप-हृ, cl. 1. P. A. -हरति, -ते, -हर्तुम्, to bring near, offer; to take away, destroy: Caus. -हारयति, -यितुम्, to cause to offer: Desid. -जिहीर्षति, to wish to offer.
उपहरणीय: उप-हरणीय or उप-हर्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be presented, to be offered as a victim.
उपहर्तृ: उप-हर्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, offering victims, serving out food &c.
उपहार: उप-हार, अस्, m. oblation; a complimentary gift, a present to a superior &c.; an offering to a deity, a victim &c.; honour; tribute, indemnification, pre-sents as the price of peace; food distributed to guests &c.; exultation, mirth (consisting in laughter, dance, song, bellowing as a bull, bowing, recital of prayer &c.).
उपहारिन्: उप-हारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, giving, presenting; sacrificing.
उपहारीकृ: उपहारी-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्-तुम्, to make an oblation, to offer.
उपहृत: उप-हृत, अस्, आ, अम्, offered, presented; im-molated, offered as a victim; served out as food; taken, collected, gathered.
उपहोम: उपहोम उप-होम, अस्, m. a supplementary sacrifice.
उपह्वर: उपह्वर उप-ह्वर, अस्, m. (rt. ह्वृ), Ved. bend, curve, arch, slope; declivity; the curved form of the Soma vessel; (अम्), n. proximity; a solitary or private place; (अस्), m. a car, a carriage; (ए), ind. in the proximity of, near to, in a private place.
उपह्वे: उपह्वे उप-ह्वे, cl. 1. P. A. -ह्वयति, -ते, -ह्वातुम्, to invoke, call near to.
उपहव: उप-हव, अस्, m. calling to, inviting, invitation; summoning, invoking; उपहवम् इष्, to wish to receive an invitation from (with loc., e. g. तस्मिन्न् इन्द्र उपहवम् ऐच्छत, Indra wished to re-ceive an invitation from him).
उपहव्य: उप-हव्य, अस्, m., N. of a ceremony.
उपहूत: उप-हूत, अस्, आ, अम्, invoked, invited.
उपहूय: उप-हूय, ind. having invoked or called or ad-dressed.
उपह्वान: उप-ह्वान, अम्, n. act of inviting.
उपांशु: उपांशु उपांशु, ind. in a low voice, in a whisper; secretly, in secret (e. g. उपांशु-व्रत, a vow observed in secret); (उस्), m. a prayer uttered in a low voice; muttering prayers, reciting them in a low voice so as not to be overheard; N. of a Soma offering. —उपांशु-क्रीडित, अस्, आ, अम्, played with in secret, made the companion of (a king's) private amusements.
उपाक: उपाक उपाक, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. अञ्च् with उप), Ved. brought near to one another, joined, approximate; (ए), Ved. du. an epithet of night and morning; (ए), ind. in the next neighbourhood, in the presence of, before. —उपाक-चक्षस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. standing present before the eyes.
उपाकृ: उपाकृ उपा-कृ (उप-आ-कृ), cl. 5. 8. P. A. -कृणोति, -नुते, -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्तुम्, to bring near or towards, to fetch; to summon, invite; to deliver, commit to, offer, grant, bestow; to acquire, obtain; to bring about, make preparations for a sacred action; to undertake, begin; to enter.
उपाकरण: उपा-करण, अम्, n. bringing near, inviting, in-vitation to begin; a term applied to certain sentences, called Praiṣas &c., with which one priest invites an-other to perform a sacrifice; immolation, sacrifice of an animal duly consecrated; preparation, begin-ning; commencement of reading the Veda after the performance of a preparatory rite.
उपाकर्मन्: उपा-कर्मन्, अ, n. preparation, beginning; a ceremony performed before reading the Vedas; be-ginning to read the Vedas.
उपाकृत: उपा-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, brought near, invited, ad-dressed with invitatory sentences; (अस्), m. a sacri-ficial animal killed during the recitation of prescribed prayers; attended with evil omens, disastrous, cala-mitous; (अस्), m. misfortune; a portent, a pheno-menon announcing calamity.
उपाक्रम्: उपाक्रम् उपा-क्रम् (उप-आ-क्रम्), cl. 1. P. A., 4. P. -क्रामति, -क्रमते (ep. also -क्रामते), -क्राम्यति, -क्रमितुम्, to advance against in order to seize, to fall upon, take possession of.
उपाक्षम्: उपाक्षम् उपाक्षम् (उप-अक्°), ind. before the eyes.
उपाख्या: उपाख्या उपा-ख्या (उप-आ-), cl. 2. P. -ख्याति, -तुम्, to tell a story, narrate; to relate or give an account about anything (with acc.); to observe (?).
उपाख्य: उपा-ख्य, अस्, आ, अम्, observable by the eyes; [cf. निर्-उपाख्य]; (अस्), m., N. of a man.
उपाख्यान: उपाख्यान (उप-आख्°), अम्, n. a tale, a short narrative, an episode; telling or repetition of a story already heard from another.
उपाख्यानक: उपाख्यानक, अम्, n. a short tale.
उपागम्: उपागम् उपा-गम् (उप-आ-), cl. 1. P. -गच्छति, -गन्तुम्, to go near or towards, to approach, visit; to return; to pass into any condition or relation; to undergo, suffer, endure; to occur, to come or fall to one's share.
उपागत: उपा-गत, अस्, आ, अम्, approached, arrived; occurred, happened; promised; suffering, feeling.
उपागम: उपा-गम, अस्, m. approach, arrival; occurrence; promise, agreement; the state of suffering, feeling.
उपागम्य: उपा-गम्य or उपा-गत्य, ind. having approached, having gone near or towards.
उपागा: उपागा उपा-गा (उप-आ-गा), cl. 3. P. -जिगाति, गातुम्, to come near, approach, come to.
उपाग्नि: उपाग्नि उपाग्नि (उप-अग्नि), ind. near a fire.
उपाग्र: उपाग्र उपाग्र (उप-अग्°), अम्, n. the part which is next to the end or top; a secondary member.
उपाग्रह्: उपाग्रह् उपा-ग्रह् (उप-आ-ग्रह्), cl. 9. P. A. -गृह्णाति, -णीते (Ved. -गृभ्णाति, -णीते), -ग्रहीतुम्, to comprehend, embrace.
उपाग्रहण: उपा-ग्रहण, अम्, n. reading the Vedas after initiation.
उपाग्रहायणम्: उपाग्रहायणम् उपाग्रहायणम् or उपाग्रहा-यणि (उप-अग्°), ind. towards the day of full moon in the month Agrahāyaṇa.
उपाघ्रा: उपाघ्रा उपा-घ्रा (उप-आ-घ्रा), cl. 1. P. -जिघ्रति, -घ्रातुम्, to smell at; to kiss.
उपाङ्क्य: उपाङ्क्य उपाङ्क्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. उप-अङ्क), to be marked.
उपाङ्ग: उपाङ्ग उपाङ्ग (उप-अङ्°), अम्, n. a sub-division; any minor limb or member; a subsidiary or supplementary work of low value; a supplement of a supplement; secondary portion of science; (twelve Aṅgas and Upāṅgas constitute the sacred writings of the Buddhists); the sectarial mark made with Sandal &c. on the forehead. —उपाङ्ग-गीत, अम्, n. a kind of song.
उपाचर्: उपाचर् उपा-चर् (उप-आ-), cl. 1. P. A. -च-रति, -ते, -रितुम्, Ved. -तवे, &c., to come near to; to attend upon, be attached to, to wait on, serve; to be obedient; to treat.
उपाचरित: उपा-चरित, अस्, आ, अम्, attached to any one's service, obedient; (in gram.) that rule of Sandhi by which the sound Visarga becomes स् before क् and प्।
उपाचार: उपा-चार, अस्, m. position (as of a word in a sentence); procedure; Sandhi by which the sound Visarga becomes स् before क् and प्।
उपाच्छिद्: उपाच्छिद् उपा-च्छिद् (उप-आ-छिद्), cl. 7. P. A. -च्छिनत्ति, -च्छिन्ते, -च्छेत्तुम्, to tear away from, cut off from.
उपाज्: उपाज् उपाज् (उप-अज्), cl. 1. P. A., Ved. उपा-जति, -ते, -जितुम्, to bring near to.
उपाजेकृ: उपाजे-कृ, to support. —उपाजे-कृत्य or उपाजे-कृत्वा, having supported.
उपाञ्च्: उपाञ्च् उपाञ्च् (उप-अञ्च्) or उपाच् (उप-अच्), cl. 1. P. A. उपाञ्चति, -ते, or उपाचति, -ते, -चितुम्, to draw (water).
उपाञ्जन: उपाञ्जन उपाञ्जन, अम्, n. (fr. rt. अञ्ज् with उप), anointing, plastering the ground with cow dung &c.
उपातिगम्: उपातिगम् उपाति-गम् (उप-अति-गम्), cl. 1. P. -गच्छति, -गन्तुम्, to pass over, cross (a river).
उपाती: उपाती उपाती (उप-अति-इ), cl. 2. P. उपात्य्-एति, -तुम्, to pass over; to be added as a surplus.
उपात्यय: उपात्य्-अय, अस्, m. neglect or disobedience of customs; disorderly behaviour.
उपादा: उपादा उपा-दा (उप-आ-दा), cl. 3. A. -दत्ते, दातुम्, to receive, accept; to gain, acquire; to take, appropriate to one's self; to take away or off, carry off, steal; to seize, lay hold of, gather; to draw (water); to assume a form; to feel, perceive, consider, regard; to take in addition, include, comprise; to employ, apply, use; to undertake, begin; to men-tion, enumerate: Caus. -दापयति, -यितुम्, to cause to employ or apply; to make use of: Desid. P. -दित्सति, to strive to obtain.
उपात्त: उपा-त्त, अस्, आ, अम्, received, accepted, acquired, gained, obtained; appropriated; taken away; seized, gathered; shaped; felt, perceived, regarded; com-prised; employed, used; begun; enumerated; allowed in argument, granted, conceded; (अस्), m. an elephant out of rut. —उपात्त-रंहस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, acquiring speed, quick, fleet. —उपात्त-शस्त्र, अस्, आ, अम्, taking up arms, armed.
उपादान: उपा-दान, अम्, n. taking, acquiring, taking away, abduction, appropriating to one's self, accepting, em-ployment, using, becoming familiar with; mentioning, enumeration; saying, speaking; including, containing; abstraction, withdrawing the organs of sense and per-ception from the outer world; cause, motive; imme-diate or proximate cause; the formal or distinct form, the material cause; a double meaning, an expression conveying a sense besides that which appears in-tended; (with Buddhists) conception; effort or ex-ertion of body or speech. —उपादान-कारण, अम्, n. a proximate cause.
उपादाय: उपा-दाय, ind. having seized, containing; includ-ing, inclusive of; together with; by means of.
उपादेय: उपा-देय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be taken or received, acceptable, admissible; to be chosen; to be selected, excellent, admirable.
उपादिक: उपादिक उपादिक, अस्, m. a sort of insect; [cf. उत्पादक।]
उपादिश्: उपादिश् उपा-दिश् (उप-आ-), cl. 6. P. A. -दि-शति, -ते, -देष्टुम्, to advise, show, point out, to indi-cate, inform, declare; to prescribe, give an order.
उपाद्रु: उपाद्रु उपा-द्रु (उप-आ-), cl. 1. P. -द्रवति, -द्रोतुम्, to run near to.
उपाधा: उपाधा उपा-धा (उप-आ-), cl. 3. P. A. -द-धाति, -धत्ते, -धातुम्, to place near, place upon; to offer; render, make, effect, fix; to keep, hold.
उपाधि: 1. उपा-धि, इस्, m. (for 2. see below), deceit, de-ception, disguise (in the Vedānta this is especially applied to certain natural forms or properties, con-sidered as disguises of the spirit); that which more closely defines, a discriminative or distinguishing pro-perty, an attribute, a peculiarity, an indispensable condition; limitation (e. g. अन्-उपाधि-रमणीयो देशः, a country beautiful without limitation, i. e. altogether beautiful); a title, a discriminative appella-tion, a nickname; a purpose, an occasion, an object; (in logic) a special cause for a general effect; (in rhetoric) the natural character of species, quality or action. उपाधि-तस्, ind. in consequence of a pe-culiarity. (At the end of a compound the affix क may be added to उपाधि, e. g. अस्त्य्-उपाधिक, having ‘is’ as an attribute.)
उपाधि 2. उपा-धि, इस्, m. (fr. rt. ध्यै with उप-आ), reflection on duty; virtuous reflection; a man who is careful to support his family. (For 1. see under उपा-धा above.)
उपाहित: उपा-हित, अस्, आ, अम्, deposited, placed; put on, worn; joined, annexed; agreed upon, made or done mutually; (अस्), m. a fiery portent, a meteor, a comet.
उपाधिक: उपाधिक उपाधिक (उप-अध्°), अस्, आ, अम्, exceeding, supernumerary.
उपाध्याय: उपाध्याय उपाध्य्-आय, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 5. इ with उप-अधि), a sub-teacher who instructs in a part only of the Veda or in grammar and the other Vedāṅgas, and is therefore inferior to the Ācārya who instructs in the whole Veda with the Kalpa and Upaniṣads (see Manu II. 141); a spiritual teacher, a teacher in general; (आ), f. a female preceptor; (ई), f. a female teacher or the wife of a teacher.
उपाध्यायानी: उपाध्यायानी, f. the wife of a teacher.
उपानस: उपानस उपानस, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. उप and अनस्), Ved. being on a carriage; (अम्), n. the space in a carriage; carriage-load; anything placed on a carriage.
उपानह्: उपानह् उपा-नह्, त्, f. (rt. नह्), a sandal, a shoe. —उपानद्-गूढ, अस्, आ, अम्, covered with a shoe.
उपानी: उपानी उपा-नी (उप-आ-), cl. 1. P. A. -नयति, -ते, -नेतुम्, to lead or carry or bring near or towards; lead away, carry off; to initiate, conse-crate; [cf. उप-नी।]
उपानुवाक्य: उपानुवाक्य उपानुवाक्य (उप-अन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. an epithet of Agni; (अम्), n., N. of a section of the Taittirīya-Saṃhitā.
उपान्त: उपान्त उपान्त (उप-अन्°), अम्, n. proximity to the edge or margin, border, edge; the angle of the eye; immediate proximity; the last letter but one; (अस्, आ, अम्), near to the end, last but one; near. —उपान्त-सर्पिन्, ई, इणी, इ, coming near.
उपान्तिक: उपान्तिक, अस्, ई, अम्, near, proximate, neighbour-ing; (अम्), n. proximity.
उपानिय: उपानिय, अस्, आ, अम्, last but one; (अस्), m. the corner of the eye; (अम्), n. vicinity.
उपाप्: उपाप् उपाप् (उप-आप्), cl. 5. P. -आप्नोति, -प्तुम्, to reach, to arrive at: Desid. उपेप्सति, to wish to reach, to desire to win over or conciliate.
उपाप: उपाप in दुर्-उपाप, अस्, आ, अम्, difficult to be obtained.
उपाप्रछ्: उपाप्रछ् उपा-प्रछ् (उप-आ-), cl. 6. P. -पृच्-छति, -प्रष्टुम्, to take leave of.
उपाभृति: उपाभृति उपा-भृति, इस्, f. (fr. rt. भृ with उप-आ), Ved. act of bringing near.
उपामन्त्र्य: उपामन्त्र्य उपा-मन्त्र्य (उप-आ-), ind. having taken leave, having received permission to go.
उपाय: उपाय उपाय। See under 1. उपे 3rd col.

उपाय, अस्, m. approaching, approach; that by which one reaches an aim, a means, an expedient, a way, stratagem; a means of success against an enemy (four of which are usually enumerated, sowing dissen-sion, negotiation, bribery, and open attack); joining (in singing &c.). —उपाय-चतुष्टय, अम्, n. the four expedients against an enemy; see above. —उपा-य-चिन्ता, f. devising an expedient, thinking of a re-source. —उपाय-ज्ञ, अस्, आ, अम्, fertile in expedients, contriving, provident. —उपाय-तस्, ind. by some means or expedient. —उपाय-तुरीय, अस्, m. a fourth means, punishment. —उपाय-त्व, अम्, n. state of being provided with means. —उपाय-योग, अस्, m. application of means or combination of expedients. —उपायान्तर (°य-अन्°), अम्, n. a remedy.
उपाया: उपाया उपा-या (उप-आ-), cl. 2. P. -याति, -तुम्, to approach, arrive at.
उपायात: उपा-यात, अस्, आ, अम्, approached; (अम्), n. arrival; an event, an accident.
उपार्: उपार् उपार् (उप-ऋ), cl. 3. P., Ved. उपे-यर्ति, उपार्तुम्, -रितुम् or -रीतुम्, to offend against, make a mistake; to injure: Caus. P. उपार्पयति, यितुम्, to bring near.
उपार: उपार, अस्, m. or उपारण, अम्, n., Ved. a mis-take, offence, sin.
उपारम्: उपारम् उपा-रम् (उप-आ-), cl. 1. A. -रमते, -रन्तुम्, to sport, take one's pleasure, delight in; to cease; to rest.
उपारत: उपा-रत, अस्, आ, अम्, delighted; engaged in, occu-pied with; frequenting, resorting to.
उपा-रत; add — ceasing, turning back, returning.
उपारम: उपा-रम, अस्, m. engaging in, going to or in.
उपाराध्: उपाराध् उपा-राध् (उप-आ-), cl. 5. P. -राध्-नोति, -राद्धुम्, to serve, wait upon.
उपाराध्य: उपा-राध्य, ind. having served, having waited on.
उपारुद्: उपारुद् उपा-रुद् (उप-आ-), cl. 2. P. -रोदिति, -रोदितुम्, to weep, deplore.
उपारुह्: उपारुह् उपा-रुह्, क्, f. (rt. रुह् with उप and आ), Ved. the shoot of a plant.
उपारूढ: उपा-रूढ, अस्, आ, अम्, grown, increased. —उपा-रूढ-स्नेह, अस्, आ, अम्, whose affection has in-creased.
उपार्ज्: उपार्ज् उपार्ज् (उप-अर्ज्), cl. 1. P. उपार्जति, जितुम्, to bring near to: Caus. उपार्जयति, -यितुम्, to cause to bring near, convey near, acquire, gain.
उपार्जक: उपार्जक, अस्, इका, अम्, acquiring, obtaining, earn-ing, gaining.
उपार्जन: उपार्जन, अम्, n. bringing near to, acquiring.
उपार्जनीय: उपार्जनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be acquired, to be earned.
उपार्जित: उपार्जित, अस्, आ, अम्, gained, acquired, earned.
उपार्थ: उपार्थ उपार्थ (उप-अर्°), अस्, आ, अम्, of little worth.
उपार्ध्: उपार्ध् उपार्ध् (उप-ऋध्), Desid. P. उपेर्त्-सति, to wish to accomplish, persevere, hold out.
उपार्ष्: उपार्ष् उपार्ष् (उप-ऋष्), cl. 6. P. उपार्षति, षितुम्, to pierce, prick, goad.
उपालभ्: उपालभ् उपा-लभ् (उप-आ-), cl. 1. A. -ल-भते, -लब्धुम्, to obtain; to censure, revile, abuse, scold.
उपालब्ध: उपा-लब्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, reproached, reviled.
उपालभ्य: उपा-लभ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, censurable, blamable.
उपालम्भ: उपा-लम्भ, अस्, m. or उपा-लम्भन, अम्, n. abuse, reviling, censure; deferring, delaying.
उपालम्भ्य: उपा-लम्भ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. to be taken in addition.

2. उपोढ, अस्, आ, अम्, brought near, brought about, advanced, commenced.
