उलूखल: उलूखल उलूखल, अम्, n. a wooden mortar used for cleansing rice from the husk &c.; bdellium, a gummy substance; (अस्), m. a staff of Udumbara wood, carried on certain occasions; N. of an evil spirit. —उलूखल-सुत, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. pressed out or pounded in a mortar.
उलूखलक: उलूखलक, अम्, n., Ved. a mortar; bdellium, a gummy substance, or the plant which produces it.
उलूखलिक: उलूखलिक, अस्, आ, अम्, pounded in a mortar, cleansed from the husk; (at the end of a compound) using as a mortar (e. g. दन्तोलूखलिक, using the teeth as a mortar).
उलूट: उलूट उलूट or उतूल or कुलूट, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people.
उलूत: उलूत उलूत, अस्, m. a large snake, the Boa.
उलूप: उलूप उलूप, अस्, m. a spreading creeper; (अम्), n. a sort of grass; (ई), f., N. of a daughter of Nāga Kauravya, married to Arjuna.
उलूलु: उलूलु उलूलु, उस्, उस्, उ or उस्, m. ululation, howling. See उलुलि।
उल्का: उल्का उल्का, f. (said to be fr. rt. 1. उष्), a fiery phenomenon in the sky, a meteor, fire falling from heaven; a firebrand; torch; fire, a flame, title of a grammar; [cf. Cambro-Brit. ulw, ‘ashes.’] —उल्का-जिह्व, अस्, m., N. of a Rakṣas. —उल्का-धारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, a torch-bearer. —उल्का-पात, अस्, m. the fall of a meteor. —उल्का-मालिन्, ई, m., N. of one of Śiva's attendants. —उल्का-मुख, अस्, m. a demon or goblin (with a face or mouth of fire who eats what is vomited, having been a negligent Brāhman in his lifetime); N. of a descendant of Ikṣvāku; (ई), f. a fox.
उल्कुषी: उल्कुषी, f. a fiery phenomenon in the sky, a meteor; firebrand. —उल्कुषी-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. accompanied by fiery phenomena.
उल्मुक: उल्मुक, अम्, n. a firebrand, wood burning or burnt as charcoal; N. of a son of Bala-rāma.
उल्मुक्य: उल्मुक्य, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging to or connected with a firebrand.
उल्ब: उल्ब उल्ब or उल्व, अम्, n. (fr. rt. वृ), Ved. the bag which surrounds the embryo; the vulva; the womb; a cave; [cf. Lat. alvus, vulva; Lith. urwa, üla; Hib. uile, ‘a corner.’]
उल्बण: उल्बण or उल्वण, अस्, आ, अम्, thick, clotted, abundant; much, exceeding, superfluous, immense, strong, powerful; abundantly furnished with; manifest; (अस्), m., N. of a son of Vasiṣṭha.
उल्ब्य: उल्ब्य, अस्, आ, अम्, with आपः, the fluid connected with the embryo; (अम्), n. excess and vitiation of any of the three humors of the body, bile, phlegm or wind; any calamity.
उल्लकसन: उल्लकसन उल्लकसन, अम्, n. horripilation, erection of the hairs of the body.
उल्लग्न: उल्लग्न उल्लग्न, अस्, m. the lagna (q. v.) of any particular place.
उल्लङ्घ्: उल्लङ्घ् उल्-लङ्घ् (उद्-ल्°), cl. 1. P. A. -लङ्-घति, -ते, -घितुम्, to leap over, pass over or beyond, to cross over; transgress, exceed, violate, spurn.
उल्लङ्घन: उल्-लङ्घन, अम्, n. leaping or passing over or beyond; transgression, exceeding.
उल्लङ्घनीय: उल्-लङ्घनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be transgressed.
उल्लङ्घित: उल्-लङ्घित, अस्, आ, अम्, jumped over or across, passed over or beyond; exceeded, transgressed, vio-lated, apostatized. —उल्लङ्घित-शासन, अस्, आ, अम्, transgressing orders, rebellious, disobedient. —उल्लङ्-घिताध्वन् (°त-अध्°), आ, आ, अ, having passed over the road.
उल्लङ्घ्य: उल्-लङ्घ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be passed over or be-yond, to be crossed; to be disregarded or neglected.
उल्लभ्: उल्लभ् उल्-लभ् (उद्-लभ्), cl. 1. A. -लभते, -लब्धुम्, to obtain.
उल्लम्बित: उल्लम्बित उल्-लम्बित (उद्-ल्°), अस्, आ, अम्, erected, elevated.
उल्लल: उल्लल उल्-लल, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. लल्), covered with thick hair; shaking, trembling.
उल्ललत्: उल्-ललत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, shaking, trembling; moving irregularly or convulsively.
उल्ललित: उल्-ललित, अस्, आ, अम्, shaken, trembling, agitated.
उल्लाल: उल्-लाल, N. of a metre of two verses, each con-taining 15 + 13 syllabic instants.
उल्लस्: उल्लस् उल्-लस् (उद्-लस्), cl. 1. P. -लसति, -सि-तुम्, to jump up, sport, play, dance, flash, shine: Caus. P. -लासयति, -यितुम्, to cause to jump up or play; to cause to shine; to divert, delight.
उल्लस: उल्-लस, अस्, आ, अम्, sporting, bright, shining; merry, happy; going out, issuing. —उल्लस-ता, f. splendor, brilliancy; mirth, happiness, going forth, issuing.
उल्लसत्: उल्-लसत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, sporting, dancing, brilliant, shining; wantoning.
उल्लसित: उल्-लसित, अस्, आ, अम्, shining, bright, splendid; happy; ejected, brought to the top or surface, drawn up, uplifted, brandishing. —उल्लसित-हरिण-केतन, अस्, आ, अम्, having its deer-marked banner gleaming or fluttering.
उल्लास: उल्-लास, अस्, m. jumping or leaping up, happiness, joy; light, splendor; (in rhetoric) giving prominence to any subject by comparison or opposition; division of a book, chapter, section (e. g. आचारोल्लास, a chapter treating of customs and observances).
उल्लासन: उल्-लासन, अस्, आ, अम्, causing to leap or dance; (अम्), n. splendor.
उल्लासित: उल्-लासित, अस्, आ, अम्, delighted, overjoyed, re-joicing.
उल्लाघ: उल्लाघ उल्लाघ, अस्, आ, अम् (said to be fr. rt. लाघ्; in some of its senses perhaps related to लघु), recovered from sickness, convalescent; dex-trous, clever, intelligent; pure; happy, delighted; wicked; black.
उल्लाप: उल्लाप उल्-लाप, अस्, m. (fr. rt. लप् with उद्), calling out in a loud voice; change of voice in grief, sickness, &c.
उल्लापिक: उल्लापिक, अस्, आ, अम्, betraying, indicating.
उल्लापिन्: उल्-लापिन्, ई, इनी, इ, calling out.
उल्लाप्य: उल्-लाप्य, अम्, n. a kind of drama.
उल्लिख्: उल्लिख् उल्-लिख् (उद्-लिख्), cl. 6. P. -लिखति, -लेखितुम्, to scratch, scrape, cut up, scarify.
उल्लिखत्: उल्-लिखत्, अन्, अती or अन्ती, अत्, scratching, scrap-ing; scarifying, making lines or streaks above or on high; painting, writing; bearing, raising.
उल्लिखित: उल्-लिखित, अस्, आ, अम्, scraped, scratched; scarified; thrown up, tossed; painted, delineated; written over or above; pared, made thin.
उल्लेख: उल्-लेख, अस्, m. description; (in rhetoric) de-scription of an object according to the different impressions caused by its appearance; speaking, utter-ance, pronunciation.
उल्लेखन: उल्-लेखन, अम्, n. scraping, scratching, scarifying, paring; digging; vomiting; raising up, elevating; uttering, utterance; writing, painting.
उल्लेख्य: उल्-लेख्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be scraped or pared; to be written.
उल्लिङ्गित: उल्लिङ्गित उल्-लिङ्गित (उद्-ल्°), अस्, आ, अम्, dis-criminated, distinguished, known.
उल्लुञ्चन: उल्लुञ्चन उल्-लुञ्चन, अम्, n. plucking out the hair; cutting the hair; pulling.
उल्लुण्ठा: उल्लुण्ठा उल्-लुण्ठा, f. (fr. rt. लुण्ठ् with उद्), irony.
उल्लू: उल्लू उल्-लू, ऊस्, ऊस्, उ (fr. rt. लू with उद्), cutting up.
उल्लोच: उल्लोच उल्-लोच, अस्, m. (rt. लोच्), an awning, a canopy.
उल्लोप्य: उल्लोप्य उल्-लोप्य, अम्, n. (rt. लुप्), N. of a song.
उल्लोल: उल्लोल उल्-लोल (उद्-ल्°), अस्, m. a large wave or billow; a surge.
उल्व: उल्व उल्व and उल्वण। See उल्ब and उल्-बण।
उवट: उवट उवट, अस्, m., N. of a scholiast on Vedic works.
उशङ्गव: उशङ्गव उशङ्गव, अस्, m., N. of a king.
उशत्: उशत् उशत्, अन्, अती, अत् (fr. rt. वश्, to desire), loving, desirous, auspicious, pleasant.
उशधक्: उश-धक्, Ved. only in connection with वन, wood (fr. उश, i. e. rt. वश् and धज्, i. e. rt. धे?; according to native etym. connected with rt. दह्), (fire) consuming (wood &c.) with desire (?); (Sāy.) desiring and burning.
उशनस्: उशनस्, आ, m., N. of a sage mentioned in the Veda and having the epithet kāvya (उशना काव्यः); in the epic poems he is identified with Śukra, the regent of the planet Venus, and described as the pre-ceptor of the Asuras or Daityas, and possessor of vast knowledge; N. of the author of a Dharma-śāstra.
उशना: उशना, ind., Ved. with desire, joyfully, with haste.
उशाना: उशाना, f., Ved. the desired one; N. of a plant, from which the Soma juice is produced.
उशिज्: उशिज्, क्, क्, क्, Ved. desiring, striving earnestly; devoted to, willing; (क्), m. ghee or boiled butter; fire; (क्), f., N. of a female slave, the mother of Kakṣīvat.
उशित: उशित, अस्, आ, अम्, wished, desired.
उशेन्य: उशेन्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. to be wished, to be longed for.
उशती: उशती उशती, f. (for रुशती, scil. वाच्), inju-rious discourse; cutting speech.
उशीनर: उशीनर उसीनर, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people or country, Kandahar; (अस्), m. the king of this country.
उशीर: उशीर उशीर, अस्, अम्, m. n. (said to be fr. rt. वश्), the fragrant root of the plant Andropogon Muricatus; (ई), f. a sort of grass, a small sort of Saccharum. —उशीर-गिरि, इस्, m., N. of a mountain. —उशीर-वीज, अस्, m., N. of a mountain.
उशीरक: उशीरक, अम्, n. the fragrant root of the plant Andropogon Muricatus.
उशीरिक: उशीरिक, अस्, ई, अम्, trading in or selling Uśīra.
उष्: उष् 1. उष्, cl. 1. P. ओषति, औषत्, उवोष or ओषाञ्-चकार, ओषिष्यति, औषीत्, ओषि-तुम्, to burn; to punish; to consume; to kill, injure: Caus. ओषयति, -यितुम्: Desid. ओषिषिषति; [cf. Lat. uro, ustus; Gr. αὔω, αὖος Hib. usga, ‘incense.’]

उष् 2. उष् (connected with rt. 3. वस्, to shine; used as a noun but only in the form उषस्), Ved. light, morning, dawn; उषस् तिस्रः, morning, midday, and evening. (The words उषस् and उषा below are connected by native authorities with 1. उष्।)
उष: 1. उष, अस्, m. bdellium; saline earth; (अम्), n. fossile salt. See ऊष।
2. उष, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. shining, brilliant; (अस्), m. early morning, dawn, day-break.
उष 3. उष, अस्, आ, अम् (connected with rt. वश्), wishing, desiring; (अस्), m. a lover.
उषण: उषण, अम्, n. black pepper; the root of Piper Longum; (आ), f. Piper Longum; Piper Chaba; dried ginger. See ऊषण।
उषप: उषप, अस्, m. fire; the sun.
उषा: 1. उषा, f. burning, scorching. (For 2. see next col.)

2. उषा, f. morning light, dawn, morning; twilight, night; a cow; N. of a wife of Bhava (who was a manifestation of Rudra); of a daughter of Bāṇa and wife of Aniruddha; (आ), ind. at day-break; at night; at twilight (?). —उषा-काल, अस्, m. a cock. —उषा-पति, इस्, m. an epithet of Aniruddha, the son of Kāmadeva and husband of Uṣā. —उषा-रमण, अस्, m. an epithet of Aniruddha. —उषेश (उषा-ईश), अस्, m. the same.
उषित: 1. उषित or उष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, burnt; quick, expeditious. (For 2. see next col.)
उषित 2. उषित, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. 1. वस्), in-habited, dwelt; fixed, remaining in or on; stale. —उषितङ्-गवीन, अस्, आ, अम्, formerly inhabited by cattle.
उष्ण: उष्ण, अस्, आ, अम् (opposed to शीत), hot, warm; pungent, acrid; sharp, active; impetuous, warm, passionate; (अस्, अम्), m. n. heat, warmth, the hot season (June and July); sunshine; a deep or feverish sigh; (अस्), m. an onion; N. of a prince; (आ), f. heat; consumption; bile. —उष्ण-कर, अस्, m. the sun (‘having hot rays’). —उष्ण-काल, अस्, m. the hot season. —उष्ण-ग, अस्, m. the hot sea-son. —उष्ण-गु, उस्, m. the sun (‘having hot rays’). —उष्णङ्-करण, अस्, ई, अम्, making hot or warm, heating. —उष्ण-ता, f. or उष्ण-त्व, अम्, n. heat, warmth. —उष्ण-दीधिति, इस्, m. the sun (‘having hot rays’). —उष्ण-नदी, f. the hot river; N. of the Vaitaraṇī or river of hell. —उष्ण-रश्मि or उष्ण-रुचि, इस्, m. the sun (‘having hot rays’). —उष्ण-वारण, अस्, अम्, m. n. an umbrella or parasol, a chattar. —उष्ण-वाष्प, अस्, m. hot vapour, steam; tears. —उष्ण-वीर्य, अस्, m. Delphinus Gangeticus. —उष्ण-वेताली, f., N. of a female deity. —उष्णांशु (°ण-अं°), उस्, m. the sun (‘having hot rays’). —उष्-णागम (°ण-आग्°), अस्, m. approach of the heat, the hot season, consisting of two months, about June and July. —उष्णाभिगम (°ण-अभ्°), अस्, m. the hot season. —उष्णासह (°ण-अस्°), अस्, m. the cold season. —उष्णोदक (°ण-उद्°), अम्, n. warm or hot water, to be drunk on certain occasions; it be-longs to the six prāṇa-karāṇi. —उष्णोपगम (°ण-उप्°), अस्, m. the hot season, summer.
उष्ण उष्ण। See under 1. उष् 1st col.
उष्णक: उष्णक, अस्, आ, अम्, sharp, smart, active; suffering pain; sick of fever; warming, heating; bent, inclin-ing, stooping; (अस्), m. the heat, the hot season (lasting for two months, about June and July); re-volving, turning round.
उष्णालु: उष्णालु, उस्, उस्, उ, suffering from heat.
उष्णीकृ: उष्णी-कृ, cl. 8. 5. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कृ-णोति, -णुते, -कर्तुम्, to make warm.
उष्णीगङ्ग: उष्णी-गङ्ग, the hot Gaṅgā, i. e. the Badarī, having hot sources; (perhaps merely a wrong reading for तूष्णीङ्गङ्ग।)
उष्म: उष्म, अस्, m. heat; the hot season (June and July); spring (April and May); anger, warmth of temper; ardour, eagerness; [cf. उष्मन् and ऊष्-मन्।] —उष्म-ता, f. = उष्ण-ता, q. v. —उष्म-पा, आस्, m. a spirit of an inferior order, a deceased ancestor; [cf. ऊष्म-प।] —उष्म-भास्, स्, m. the sun (‘having hot beams’). —उष्म-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, heated, burning, smoking. —उष्म-स्वेद, अस्, m. a vapour bath. —उष्मागम (°म-आग्°), अस्, m. the hot sea-son. —उष्मान्वित (°म-अन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, enraged. —उष्मोपगम (°म-उप्°), अस्, m. the hot season.
उष्मक: उष्मक, अस्, m. the hot season.
उष्मन्: उष्मन्, आ, m. heat, ardour, steam; the hot season.
उष्माय: उष्माय, nom. A. उष्मायते, to emit heat or steam. See ऊष्माय।
उष्मायण: उष्मायण, अस्, m. the hot season.
उषस्: उषस्, आस्, f. morning light, dawn, morning; per-sonified as the daughter of Heaven and sister of the Ādityas; evening light; उषसौ or उषासौ, du. the two dawns, i. e. night and day; the outer passage of the ear; the Malaya range; (सी), f. the end of the day, twilight; [cf. Gr. ἠώς Lat. aurora; Lith. auszra; Goth. uh-tvô; Old Germ. uohta.] —उषर्-बुध्, भुत्, त्, त्, Ved. awaking with the morning light, early awaked. —उषर्-बुध, अस्, m. fire; a child. —उषासा-नक्ता, f. du., Ved. dawn and night. —उषो-देवत्य, अस्, आ, अम्, whose deity is the dawn.
उषस्य: 1. उषस्य, nom. P. उषस्यति, -यितुम्, to be-come day.
2. उषस्य, अस्, आ, अम्, sacred to the dawn.
उस्र: 1. उस्र, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. relating to or seen in the morning; bright; shining; clear; (Sāy. उत्सरण-शील) rising on high; (अस्), m. a ray of light; (आ), f. morning light, dawn, morning; light, bright sky. —उस्र-धन्वन्, आ, m. having a bright bow; an epithet of Indra. —उस्र-यामन्, आ, आ, अ, Ved. going out in the early morning light (as the carriage of the Aśvins); going out at daylight.
उस्र 2. उस्र, अस्, m. a bull; (आ), f. a cow; the plant Anthericum Tuberosum. (For 1. see last col.)
उषत्: उषत्, अन्, m., N. of a son of Suyajña.
उषङ्गु: उषङ्गु उषङ्गु, उस्, m. an epithet of Śiva; [cf. उशङ्गव।]
उषती: उषती उषती, f. injurious discourse; cutting speech. See उशती।
उषद्गु: उषद्गु उषद्गु, उस्, m., N. of a son of Svāhi.
उषद्रथ: उषद्रथ उषद्रथ, अस्, m. a son of Titikṣu.
उषस्त: उषस्त उषस्त, अस्, m., N. of a man, with the patronymic cākrāyaṇa.
उष्य: उष्य, ind. (irreg. form for उषित्वा), having resided or dwelt.
उषीर: उषीर उषीर, अस्, अम्, m. n. the root of Andropogon Muricatum. See उशीर।
उष्ट्र: उष्ट्र उष्ट्र, अस्, m. (said to be fr. 1. उष्), a buffalo; a bull with a hump; a camel; a cart, a waggon; N. of an Asura; (ई), f. a she-camel; an earthen vessel in the shape of a camel. —उष्ट्र-कर्णिक, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people. —उष्ट्र-काण्डी, f. a flower of a red colour. —उष्ट्र-क्रोशिन्, ई, इनी, इ, making a noise like a camel. —उष्ट्र-गोयुग, अम्, n. a couple of camels. —उष्ट्र-ग्रीव, अस्, m. hemorrhoids. —उष्ट्र-धूसर-पुच्छिका, f. the plant Tragia Involucrata. —उष्ट्र-पादिका, f. the plant Jasminum Sambac. —उष्ट्र-यान, अम्, n. a camel-litter, a vehicle drawn by camels. —उष्ट्र-शिरो-धर, अम्, n. hemorrhoids, piles, bleeding piles. —उष्ट्र-स्थान, अम्, n. a stable for camels; (अस्, आ, अम्), born in a camel-stable.
उष्टृ: उष्टृ, टा, m., Ved. a bull drawing a plough.
उष्ट्रिका: उष्ट्रिका, f. a she-camel; an earthen vessel of the shape of a camel.
उष्णिह्: उष्णिह् उष्णिह्, क्, f. (fr. उद्-स्निह् ?), N. of a Vedic metre of three Pādas, the first two containing eight each, and the third twelve syllables; a classical metre of four Pādas of seven syllables; a brick sacred to the metre Uṣṇih. —उष्णिक्छन्दस्क, अस्, आ, अम्, having the metre Uṣṇih. —उष्णिग्-गर्भा, f., N. of a Gāyatrī of three Pādas of six, seven, eleven syllables respectively.
उष्णिहा: उष्णिहा, f. the metre Uṣṇih; (आस्), pl., Ved. the nape of the neck.
उष्णीष: उष्णीष उष्णीष, अस्, अम्, m. n. (said to be connected with उष्ण), anything wound round the head; a turban, a diadem; a bandage of any kind; a distinguishing mark; the hair with which a Buddha is born and which indicates his future sanctity. —उष्-णीष-धारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, wearing a turban, turbaned.
उष्णीषिन्: उष्णीषिन्, ई, इणी, इ, furnished with a turban; an epithet of Śiva.
उष्यल: उष्यल उष्यल, अम्, n., Ved. the frame (of a bed).
उस्रि: उस्रि, इस्, f., Ved. a cow (?).
उस्रिक: उस्रिक, अस्, m., Ved. a small ox.
उस्रिय: उस्रिय, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. belonging to or coming from a cow or ox; (अस्), m. an ox; (आ), f. a cow; a calf; milk.
उस्रीय: उस्रीय, nom. P. उस्रीयति, -यितुम्, to desire or wish for a cow.
उह्: उह् उह्, cl. 1. P. ओहति, उवोह, ओहितुम्, to hurt or give pain; to kill, to destroy. See ऊह्।
उहन्: उहन्, Ved. a wrong reading for उदन्।
उहान: उहान, अस्, m., N. of a country.
उहू: उहू उहू, ऊस्, ऊस्, उ (fr. rt. वह्), Ved. bear-ing, carrying.
उह्यमान: उह्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being conveyed, borne along.
उह्यगान: उह्यगान उह्यगान, a various reading for ऊह्यगान, q. v.
उच्छोथ: उच्-छोथ (उद्-श्°), अस्, m. (fr. rt. श्वि with उद्), swelling, intumescence.
उणादि: उण्-आदि, a class of Kṛt affixes beginning with उण्।
उत्कुटकासन: उत्कुटकासन; add — sitting with the legs bent underneath.
उत्तानपाणिद्वय: उत्तान-पाणि-द्वय, अस्, आ, अम्, having the two hands with the concave of the palms turned upwards.
उत्थायित्व: उत्थायि-त्व, अम्, n. effort, energy, activity.
उत्प्रबाल: उत्-प्रबाल, अस्, आ, अम्, shooting out fresh foliage.
उत्सर्पिणी: उत्-सर्पिणी; add — ‘ascending scale,’ divided into six stages (beginning with bad-bad, and rising upwards in the reverse order to अव-सर्पिणी, q. v., col. 2).
उत्स्रोतस्: उत्-स्रोतस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, having the flow of life or current of nutriment upwards (opposed to अर्वाक्-स्रोतस्, q. v.).
उदाशय: उदाशय (°द-आश्°), अस्, अम्, m. n. a lake, tank.
उद्धर्म: उद्-धर्म, अस्, m. an erroneous doctrine, heresy.
उद्यमित: उद्-यमित, अस्, आ, अम्, excited, instigated.
उन्नहन: उन्-नहन, अस्, आ, अम्, unfettered, unrestrained.
उन्नामित: उन्-नामित, अस्, आ, अम्, raised up.
उन्मणि: उन्-मणि, इस्, m. a jewel found on the surface of the ground (= बहिः-प्रकट).
उपक्रान्त: उप-क्रान्त, अस्, आ, अम्, previously mentioned.
उपगान: उप-गान, अम्, n. an accompanying song.
उपचारिक: उप-चारिक, अस्, आ, अम्, serviceable, useful.
उपचीर्ण: उप-चीर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, attended; deceived (= वञ्चित).
उपच्छन्द: उप-च्छन्द, अस्, m. an implement, instrument.
उपतीर्थ: उप-तीर्थ, अम्, n. steps leading down to a river.
उपमज्जन: उप-मज्जन, अम्, n. ablution, bathing, a bath.
उपमित्र: उप-मित्र, अम्, n. a secondary or inferior friend.
उपमेखलम्: उप-मेखलम्, ind. about or on the slopes or sides (of a mountain).
उपयत्: उप-यत्, अन्, अती, अत् (fr. उपे), flowing into, going near, approaching, tributary (as a river).
उपव्रजम्: उप-व्रजम्, ind. near a cattle pen.
उपसिक्त: उप-सिक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, sprinkled with.
उपसीम: उप-सीम, ind. near the boundary (of a field).
उपसेक: उप-सेक, अस्, m. sprinkling upon, infusion.
उपहार्य: उप-हार्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be presented or offered; (अम्), n. an offering, oblation.
उपानयन: उपा-नयन, अम्, n. the act of leading or conduct-ing home.
उपासद्: उपा-सद् (उप-आ°), cl. 1. P. -सीदति, &c., to ap-proach, walk along.
उरसिकृ: उरसि-कृ or उरसि कृ, cl. 8. P. -करोति, &c., to appropriate, make one's own.
उराण: उराण, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. making broad, (Sāy. = उरु-कुर्वाण।)
